Ahora, para conseguir los 5.000 millones de dólares previstos de emisiones locales, la tasa a convalidar es más del 11%, algo que hasta hace poco era considerado caro", expresó Roberto Geretto, analista de Adcap Grupo Financiero.

item.title: Starbucks sued over 'sugar-free' claims for protein beverages
item.description: Starbucks has been sued by consumers who said the coffee chain falsely advertised eight protein beverages as "sugar-free" because they contain lactose, a naturally occurring sugar in milk.
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Stempel
item.content:encoded: Starbucks (SBUX.O) has been sued by consumers who said the coffee chain falsely advertised eight protein beverages as "sugar-free" because they contain lactose, a naturally occurring sugar in milk. According to a proposed class action filed on Friday, reasonable consumers would not expect the beverages to contain 13 to 21 grams of sugar per 20- or 24-ounce "venti" serving. Federal law prohibits Starbucks from using "sugar-free" to describe beverages containing more than 0.5 grams of sugar per 12-ounce serving, the complaint said. Consumers accused Starbucks of trying to capitalize on the desire of 75% of Americans to reduce or eliminate sugar consumption. They also said Starbucks failed to provide federally required disclaimers that the protein beverages are not low-calorie food or meant for weight control. Starbucks, based in Seattle, had no immediate comment on Monday. A lawyer for the consumers did not immediately respond to requests for comment. The complaint in Seattle federal court seeks unspecified damages for false advertising and violations of various state consumer protection laws. Food producers are regularly sued for alleged false advertising, including in dozens of recent cases challenging "sugar-free" or "zero sugar" claims for products containing a sugar substitute known as allulose. The eight Starbucks beverages are Sugar-Free Vanilla Protein Latte, Sugar-Free Caramel Protein Latte, Sugar-Free Vanilla Protein Matcha, Sugar-Free Caramel Protein Matcha, and equivalent versions containing ice. The Starbucks website says the beverages are "protein-packed" with "no added sugar," and venti servings contain between 270 and 340 calories. The company launched the beverages in September 2025 as part of its "Back to Starbucks" updated menu.

item.title: US advances first government-funded trials of psychedelic drug ibogaine
item.description: US health officials are advancing the first government-funded clinical trials of the psychedelic drug ibogaine to treat opioid addiction and post-traumatic stress disorder, the FDA said on Monday, as it sought public feedback on safety rules for the studies.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US health officials are advancing the first government-funded clinical trials of the psychedelic drug ibogaine to treat opioid addiction and post-traumatic stress disorder, the FDA said on Monday, as it sought public feedback on safety rules for the studies. The initiative follows an April executive order by President Donald Trump dedicating [USN:L6N41103Y TEXT:"$50 million"] to federal ibogaine research, as well as [USN:L1N4560R3 TEXT:"recent calls"] by experts and veterans for strict safety standards on psychedelic treatments. The Department of Health and Human Services is funding early-stage trials through the Advanced Research Projects Agency for Health and the National Institute on Drug Abuse. Ibogaine, a compound found in the roots of the [USN:L1N4570B8 TEXT:"African shrub iboga"], is classified as an illegal Schedule I controlled substance under US law. However, it has gained attention from military veterans who have traveled abroad seeking relief from trauma and addiction. "Patients facing serious conditions that have not responded to existing treatments deserve rigorous scientific investigation of promising new approaches," said Michael Davis, director of the FDA's Center for Drug Evaluation and Research. Davis said the agency will prioritize patient safety. The Food and Drug Administration has warned that the drug carries severe health risks, including life-threatening irregular heart rhythms and potential brain toxicity. The regulator has opened a public docket seeking feedback on trial design, dose selection, patient eligibility, safety monitoring, study-stopping rules and oversight by November 20. The information could help inform future reviews of applications to test ibogaine in humans. Under initial trial approaches outlined by the FDA, participants would receive single, gradual doses capped at 10 milligrams per kilogram and remain under continuous hospital heart monitoring for up to 36 hours.

item.title: Amundi Asset Management takes a more positive view on British pound
item.description: Europe's largest asset manager Amundi has taken a more positive view on sterling in the past month, partly as concern around French fiscal worries hurt euro zone markets, its head of global currencies said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Europe's largest asset manager Amundi has taken a more positive view on sterling in the past month, partly as concern around French fiscal worries hurt euro zone markets, its head of global currencies said on Monday. Sterling rallied over 1% against the euro last week, its biggest weekly jump since March, and is trading around 84.76 pence per euro . The euro has [USN:L6N45R0KQ TEXT:"been hurt"] as concerns about France's ability to rein in its budget deficit spark sharp selling in French bonds, leaving currency investors to look for alternatives. Andreas König, head of global FX at Amundi Asset Management said they were positive on the dollar, and also had recently taken a more upbeat view on the pound. "Sterling is an interesting one when we talk about currencies, first because of the technical situation, there was so much negativity for sterling and the UK -- where there is also a budget and political changes," he said. "As long as politicians can show they're acting with fiscal respect, the market takes it as relatively positive for the currency. So, as an alternative, sterling was gaining as well with a weaker euro." König said Amundi had shifted to a more positive sterling view over the past month and had a slightly overweight position on the pound against other major currencies. Britain's new finance minister John Healey said he will put [USN:L8N45K0OQ TEXT:"fiscal discipline at the core"] of his first budget on October 28.

item.title: Triunfo de la derecha en el Congreso de Brasil da impulso a Bolsonaro de cara a balotaje presidencial
item.description: El derechista Partido Liberal de Brasil, del que forma parte el senador y candidato presidencial Flávio Bolsonaro, se erigió como el gran ganador de las elecciones al Congreso celebradas el domingo, al conseguir la mayor representación de un solo partido tanto en el Senado como en la Cámara de Diputados.
item.dc:creator: Fernando Cardoso, Ricardo Brito, Lisandra Paraguassu
item.content:encoded: El derechista Partido Liberal de Brasil, del que forma parte el senador y candidato presidencial Flávio Bolsonaro, se erigió como el gran ganador de las elecciones al Congreso celebradas el domingo, al conseguir la mayor representación de un solo partido tanto en el Senado como en la Cámara de Diputados. El senador Bolsonaro, hijo mayor del expresidente Jair Bolsonaro, obtuvo el domingo el mayor número de votos en la primera vuelta de las elecciones presidenciales, pasando así a la segunda vuelta, que se disputará el 25 de octubre contra el presidente izquierdista Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Durante la campaña, el joven Bolsonaro respaldó a menudo a candidatos aliados al Senado. Su Partido Liberal (PL) aumentó su representación en el Senado de 15 a 28 escaños, el mejor resultado para un partido desde el retorno de Brasil a la democracia en 1985. También se aseguró 121 escaños en la Cámara de Diputados, según mostraron las proyecciones para esa cámara, frente a los 98 escaños actuales. Si a ello se suman otros partidos y bloques de centro-derecha, que según las previsiones obtendrían cerca de 250 escaños en la Cámara Baja y más de 30 en el Senado, la agenda de Bolsonaro parece destinada a contar con una sólida mayoría de trabajo en el próximo Congreso. Un Congreso afín —y, en particular, un Senado afín— ayudaría al joven Bolsonaro a alcanzar su objetivo de conceder la amnistía a su padre, que cumple una condena de 27 años por planear un golpe de Estado tras perder las elecciones de 2022. El bloque pro-Bolsonaro del Senado podría incluso estar cerca del umbral de 54 votos necesarios para destituir a los magistrados del Supremo Tribunal Federal que condenaron al exlíder de extrema derecha. "Me alegró mucho ver cuántos brasileños acudieron a las urnas para hacer oír su voz y no se quedaron al margen porque quieren un cambio", dijo Bolsonaro tras la votación. Las elecciones legislativas del domingo, celebradas junto con la primera vuelta de las presidenciales, renovaron los 513 escaños de la Cámara de Diputados y dos tercios de los 81 escaños del Senado. Las elecciones al Congreso en Brasil han suscitado una atención cada vez mayor entre el electorado en las últimas elecciones, a medida que los legisladores amplían su influencia en la capital, Brasilia, sobre todo a través de un mayor control sobre el gasto federal y su influencia en los nombramientos presidenciales. El Partido de los Trabajadores (PT) de Lula también aumentó su presencia en el Congreso. El partido mantuvo su presencia en el Senado con nueve escaños, y se prevé que un bloque tripartito liderado por el PT obtenga 88 escaños en la Cámara Baja, frente a los 82 actuales. DESAFÍOS DE GOBERNANZA A pesar de que Lula lucha por remontar y lograr la victoria en la segunda vuelta, los analistas dicen que el próximo Congreso convertiría su cuarto mandato, no consecutivo, en una ardua batalla. "La gobernanza supondría un gran reto para el presidente Lula", dijo Neuriberg Dias, director del organismo de control legislativo DIAP, y añadió que un bloque de derecha trabajaría para frenar el avance legislativo y el funcionamiento del Gobierno. Ambos bandos políticos han puesto de manifiesto las dificultades a las que se enfrentan los presidentes que no cuentan con un respaldo suficiente en el Congreso. En abril, Lula se convirtió en el primer presidente brasileño en más de un siglo en ver rechazada la candidatura de un juez al Supremo Tribunal Federal, en medio de tensiones con el presidente del Senado, Davi Alcolumbre, de centro-derecha. El Congreso también ha anulado decenas de vetos de Lula desde su regreso al cargo en enero de 2023, lo que pone de relieve la creciente asertividad de los legisladores. El expresidente Bolsonaro se enfrentó a obstáculos similares, ya que el Congreso bloqueó algunas de sus iniciativas políticas más destacadas, entre ellas los intentos de flexibilizar las normas de control de armas e introducir un sistema de verificación de papeletas impresas para las elecciones.

item.title: Giorgia Meloni registra voce come marchio Ue contro deepfake
item.description: La presidente del Consiglio Giorgia Meloni ha depositato all'Ufficio dell'Unione europea per la proprietà intellettuale (Euipo) una domanda per registrare come marchio la propria voce, in una nuova iniziativa volta a proteggersi dai deepfake generati dall'intelligenza artificiale.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La presidente del Consiglio Giorgia Meloni ha depositato all'Ufficio dell'Unione europea per la proprietà intellettuale (Euipo) una domanda per registrare come marchio la propria voce, in una nuova iniziativa volta a proteggersi dai deepfake generati dall'intelligenza artificiale. La domanda, che riporta la data di oggi sul sito dell'Euipo, e che è stata dal suo ufficio, include una registrazione audio di quattro secondi nella quale Meloni ripete due volte la frase "Io sono Giorgia Meloni". "Io sono Giorgia" è il titolo della sua autobiografia pubblicata nel 2021, che riprendeva una celebre dichiarazione pronunciata durante un comizio nel 2019. La domanda presentata all'Euipo è ancora in fase di esame. Negli ultimi anni sono circolate ripetutamente online immagine manipolate della premier, talvolta condivise come autentiche, tra cui una che la ritraeva seduta su un letto in biancheria intima. Meloni ha denunciato questo tipo di materiale come parte di una campagna di disinformazione mirata e ha esortato gli utenti a verificare i contenuti prima di condividerli online. Ha anche sottolineato che, sebbene lei sia in grado di difendersi, molte altre persone non lo sono.

item.title: Joven pierde una mano durante protestas en colegios franceses, que entran en su tercera semana
item.description: Un joven perdió una mano durante los enfrentamientos del lunes entre manifestantes de institutos y la policía antidisturbios en el norte de Francia, según informó una autoridad local, en vísperas de una protesta nacional convocada por el sindicato de alumnos contra la falta de financiación, el hacinamiento y el deterioro de las aulas.
item.dc:creator: Dominique Vidalon, Inti Landauro
item.content:encoded: Un joven perdió una mano durante los enfrentamientos del lunes entre manifestantes de institutos y la policía antidisturbios en el norte de Francia, según informó una autoridad local, en vísperas de una protesta nacional convocada por el sindicato de alumnos contra la falta de financiación, el hacinamiento y el deterioro de las aulas. El periódico regional La Voix du Nord informó de que el joven, de 15 años, perdió la mano y parte del antebrazo después de que detonó una granada aturdidora de la policía que había recogido en la localidad de Lens, en un momento en que la ola de protestas escolares entra en su tercera semana. François-Xavier Lauch, prefecto de Pas-de-Calais, se negó a comentar las circunstancias exactas y señaló que entre 200 y 250 manifestantes habían estado lanzando objetos contra la policía. A seis meses de las elecciones para sustituir al presidente Emmanuel Macron, su Gobierno y el partido de extrema derecha Reagrupamiento Nacional acusan a los diputados y alcaldes del partido de izquierda radical La Francia Insumisa (LFI) de estar avivando las protestas, una acusación que la formación rechaza. Las organizaciones de derechos humanos acusan a la policía de emplear tácticas de mano dura contra menores, incluyendo porras, gas lacrimógeno y balas de goma. Entre las diversas investigaciones sobre los métodos policiales, las autoridades están examinando el caso de un joven de 16 años que sufrió una lesión ocular después de que la policía disparara balas de goma contra una multitud de manifestantes, según sus amigos. LFI, liderada por el candidato presidencial Jean-Luc Mélenchon, niega haber incitado a la violencia y acusa al Gobierno de politizar el asunto y de descuidar los intereses de los alumnos. Las protestas han ejercido una mayor presión sobre un Gobierno que intenta reducir el déficit presupuestario, a medida que crece la preocupación de los inversores por las finanzas del Estado, lo que la semana pasada llevó brevemente el rendimiento de los bonos franceses a 10 años a su máximo en 24 años, por encima del 5%, y aumentó el costo probable de los futuros préstamos.

item.title: Usa, settore servizi rallenta a settembre, aumentano pressioni sui prezzi
item.description: L'attività del settore dei servizi statunitense ha registrato un rallentamento a settembre, con la forte domanda interna che ha messo a dura prova le catene di approvvigionamento e fatto aumentare i prezzi pagati dalle imprese per i fattori produttivi. Un segnale del fatto che l'inflazione potrebbe rimanere elevata anche il prossimo anno.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L'attività del settore dei servizi statunitense ha registrato un rallentamento a settembre, con la forte domanda interna che ha messo a dura prova le catene di approvvigionamento e fatto aumentare i prezzi pagati dalle imprese per i fattori produttivi. Un segnale del fatto che l'inflazione potrebbe rimanere elevata anche il prossimo anno. L'Institute for Supply Management ha comunicato che il proprio indice dei responsabili degli acquisti (Pmi) per il settore non manifatturiero, che rappresenta oltre due terzi dell'attività economica statunitense è sceso a 54,9 il mese scorso, da 55,4 di agosto. Un valore superiore a 50 indica una crescita. Gli economisti interpellati da Reuters avevano previsto un Pmi pressoché invariato a 55,2. Il Pmi resta coerente con una robusta crescita economica del terzo trimestre. L'economia continua ad essere trainata da una solida domanda interna, sostenuta principalmente dalla spesa dei consumatori e dagli investimenti delle imprese nell'intelligenza artificiale e nelle relative infrastrutture. Sul fronte degli ordini, l'indicatore relativo alle nuove commesse nel settore dei servizi è sceso a 59,8, dopo il picco di 60,9 ad agosto, il valore più alto da febbraio 2023. Le catene di approvvigionamento stanno faticando a tenere il passo con la forte domanda, una situazione aggravata dalla guerra di Stati Uniti e Israele contro l'Iran. Il conflitto in Medio Oriente ha fatto salire i prezzi dell'energia e causato carenze di materie prime trasportate attraverso lo Stretto di Hormuz. I prezzi del gasolio hanno raggiunto livelli record e potrebbero iniziare a esercitare pressioni non solo nei settori dei trasporti e dell'agricoltura. L'indice relativo alle consegne dei fornitori è salito a 53,2 da 51,3 di agosto. Un valore superiore a 50 indica tempi di consegna più lunghi. Questo indicatore segnala un rallentamento delle consegne da 22 mesi consecutivi, contribuendo all'aumento dei costi dei fattori produttivi. Le performance di consegna dei fornitori sono state inizialmente influenzate dai dazi sulle importazioni. L'indice dei prezzi pagati dalle imprese per i fattori produttivi è balzato a 74,0 da 72,6 di agosto. Questo dato rispecchia un incremento analogo rilevato dall'indagine Ism sul settore manifatturiero. Nel complesso, le due indagini prefigurano un'inflazione più elevata nei prossimi mesi e avvalorano le aspettative degli economisti secondo cui la Federal Reserve alzerà i tassi di interesse a dicembre. Il mese scorso la Fed ha alzato per la prima volta in tre anni il tasso di riferimento 'overnight' di 25 punti base, portandolo nell'intervallo 3,75%-4,00%, e ha preannunciato ulteriori aumenti del costo del denaro. Le probabilità di un rialzo dei tassi questo mese si sono ridotte a causa dei dati sull'inflazione di agosto e luglio, inferiori alle attese, e del brusco rallentamento della crescita degli occupati non agricoli a settembre. L'indagine Ism ha evidenziato un aumento dell'occupazione nel settore dei servizi, con l'indice che è salito a 50,1 da 47,8 di agosto. Questo dato, insieme all'incremento dell'occupazione nel settore manifatturiero rilevato dall'Ism la scorsa settimana, ha confermato la valutazione degli economisti secondo cui il mercato del lavoro è rimasto stabile nonostante la crescita deludente degli occupati a settembre.

item.title: Intesa's MPS bid set to redraw Italian banking landscape
item.description: Italy's Intesa Sanpaolo has sweetened its €34 billion ($38 billion) share-and-cash bid for Monte dei Paschi di Siena and won the backing of its target's main investor.
item.dc:creator: Valentina Za
item.content:encoded: Italy's Intesa Sanpaolo has sweetened its €34 billion ($38 billion) share-and-cash bid for Monte dei Paschi di Siena (BMPS.MI) and won [USN:L1N45R04Z TEXT:"the backing"] of its target's main investor. But the bid by Italy's largest lender for the country's biggest mid-sized bank has stirred competition concerns after two years of sector consolidation. The next hurdle for Intesa (ISP.MI) is a decision by Italy's antitrust authority, which a person close to the matter said is due between the middle and end of November. Here's a look in four charts at the competitive structure of the euro zone's fourth-largest banking market. ANTITRUST HURDLE Italy's antitrust body is expected to eventually clear Intesa's acquisition of MPS with conditions. The authority, which last month [USN:L8N4571F8 TEXT:"opened an in-depth probe into the deal"], declined to comment. Intesa (ISP.MI) has already agreed to sell half of MPS' branches, echoing a scheme it used in a [USN:KBN20C065 TEXT:"2020 deal that turned it into"] Italy's biggest bank. Of the 635 MPS branches it will sell, Intesa has irrevocably selected 445, while it can make changes to another 190 to help with any further antitrust problems. Intesa could have to sell more branches than planned, two people close to the matter said, with one saying it may have to shed up to 50 more. Antitrust measures could also affect the stake in insurer Generali (GASI.MI) that Intesa will gain through MPS, the people said. HOW FRAGMENTED IS ITALIAN BANKING? Italy has sharply reduced banking fragmentation. A bad loan crisis led to rescue deals, including a government-funded sale of two banks to Intesa in 2017, and a reform forced cooperative lenders to merge. Germany has seen a much smaller rise in the ECB concentration index. Italy's latest consolidation round has seen [USN:L8N44L13B TEXT:"roughly a dozen deal proposals"] surface since late 2024, of which half went through. The completion of MPS' reprivatisation in November 2024, after a 2017 bailout, kickstarted the process. It was expected to bring together other second-tier players: Banco BPM (BAMI.MI) and BPER (EMII.MI) . But UniCredit (CRDI.MI) upended a prospective MPS-BPM tie-up and forced MPS to pursue merchant bank Mediobanca instead. The deal restored MPS to third place among Italian banks, but with less than a third of Intesa's assets. To fight off Intesa, MPS CEO Luigi Lovaglio proposed buying both BPM and wealth manager Banca Generali (BGN.MI) , but the chances of shareholder approval for his scheme have dwindled after the top MPS [USN:L1N45R08I TEXT:"investor on Sunday sided with Intesa"]. WHAT NEXT? Under Intesa's plan, Unipol-owned BPER will surge to third place in Italian banking by adding 635 MPS branches. That would leave a very significant size gap between Italy's top two banks and the country's third largest. BPM could claim the No.3 spot [USN:S8N3PN03A TEXT:"if a merger"] with the Italian arm of France's Credit Agricole (CA) (CAGR.PA) , its main shareholder and [USN:L1N43X13W TEXT:"a supporter of the deal"], goes through. But it would still be a distant third to Intesa and UniCredit, while increasing concentration measured as the proportion of assets held by the top five banks. This would rise further if UniCredit pursues plans to buy any assets others have to shed for antitrust purposes. IMPLICATIONS FOR BANK RATES Concentration is good for profit margins, with Spanish and Italian banks gaining from the 2022-2024 rate-hiking cycle more than German and French rivals because they managed to pass higher rates on to borrowers more quickly than to savers. French and German households were quicker to move their money into higher-yielding time deposits, while sight deposits remained predominant in Italy and Spain. ($1 = 0.8935 euros)

item.title: Importações de óleo de girassol pela Índia têm menor nível em 4 anos
item.description: As importações indianas de óleo de girassol caíram em setembro para o nível mais baixo em mais de quatro anos, depois que a guerra na Ucrânia interrompeu os embarques, levando as refinarias a aumentar as compras de óleo de palma para o nível mais alto em sete meses, segundo cinco corretores.
item.dc:creator: Rajendra Jadhav
item.content:encoded: As importações indianas de óleo de girassol caíram em setembro para o nível mais baixo em mais de quatro anos, depois que a guerra na Ucrânia interrompeu os embarques, levando as refinarias a aumentar as compras de óleo de palma para o nível mais alto em sete meses, segundo cinco corretores. O aumento nas compras de óleo de palma pelo maior importador mundial de óleos vegetais favorece Indonésia e Malásia, os dois maiores produtores globais. As importações de óleo de girassol da Índia despencaram 36% em relação ao mês anterior, para 103.000 toneladas métricas em setembro, o menor nível desde abril de 2022, segundo estimativas médias dos corretores. As importações de óleo de palma aumentaram 3,5% em relação ao mês anterior, atingindo uma máxima de sete meses de 810.000 toneladas, enquanto os embarques de óleo de soja caíram 4,6% em relação ao recorde do mês anterior, para 600.000 toneladas. As importações de óleos comestíveis caíram 3,75%, para 1,5 milhão de toneladas, impulsionadas pela redução nos embarques de óleo de girassol e óleo de soja. A Associação de Extratores por Solvente da Índia deve publicar seus dados de importação de setembro até meados de outubro. A guerra na Ucrânia danificou a infraestrutura portuária no Mar Negro, dificultando o envio de óleo de girassol para a Índia, apesar da boa demanda, disse Rajesh Patel, sócio-gerente da empresa de comercialização GGN Research, na cidade de Rajkot, no estado de Gujarat, no oeste do país. "Mesmo em outubro, as importações de óleo de girassol permanecerão baixas devido a restrições logísticas", disse Patel. A Índia obtém a maior parte de seu óleo de palma da Indonésia e da Malásia, enquanto o óleo de soja e o óleo de girassol são importados principalmente da Argentina, do Brasil, da Rússia e da Ucrânia. As importações de óleo de palma aumentaram no mês passado, à medida que as refinarias buscavam formar estoques antes da próxima temporada de festivais, disse um corretor de uma empresa de comércio internacional com sede em Mumbai. A Índia celebra uma série de festivais entre setembro e novembro, quando a demanda por óleos comestíveis costuma atingir seu pico. (Reportagem de Rajendra Jadhav)

item.title: What to know about Spain's November snap election
item.description: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez has called an early election for November 29 that he hopes will hand him a parliamentary majority but which could just as easily usher in a conservative coalition, as the centre-left bloc trails in most opinion polls.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez has [USN:L8N45R05N TEXT:"called an early election"] for November 29 that he hopes will hand him a parliamentary majority but which could just as easily usher in a conservative coalition, as the centre-left bloc trails in most opinion polls. Here is what you need to know about the election: POLLS PITCH RIGHT-WING COALITION AS LIKELIEST OUTCOME Sanchez's Socialist Party (PSOE) has long trailed in the polls, hovering around 28% and never above 33% throughout his eight years in office. Parties further to the left, which will be key for Sanchez to cobble together a coalition, are currently polling at around 8%. A coalition between the conservative People's Party (PP) and far-right Vox is the only combination projected to win enough votes for an absolute majority in the 350-seat lower house of parliament. Voting intention for Vox stands at roughly 18%, propelled by younger and male voters. ISSUES LIKELY TO DOMINATE THE ELECTORAL CAMPAIGN Housing will dominate the left's agenda, with Sanchez taking the decision to call the election after protests erupted across the country following the high-profile eviction of an 87-year-old woman from her Madrid home. Immigration is likely to be another defining issue, both for Sanchez as one of Europe's loudest advocates of immigration's benefits for society and the economy, recently [USN:L8N42N0Y2 TEXT:"granting legal status"] to nearly a million undocumented migrants, and for Vox, which wants far tighter controls. The mass crossing of 72,000 migrants [USN:L8N43W1SU TEXT:"into Ceuta in July"] has overwhelmed local authorities and triggered major political disputes over Spain's ability to control its borders. Corruption: Opposition parties are expected to make corruption a central theme of the election campaign, seeking to tie Sanchez to a series of investigations, trials and convictions involving members of his [USN:L8N42U0LE TEXT:"inner circle"] and [USN:L1N42S02V TEXT:"family"]. Sanchez has repeatedly denied any wrongdoing and argued that some of the cases form part of a [USN:L1N4260JB TEXT:"politically motivated campaign"] against his government. CANDIDATES FOR PRIME MINISTER Sanchez, the incumbent, will run again for the Socialists, having spearheaded the party since 2017. Now seeking a third term after eight years in office, he is already Spain's second-longest-serving premier since the country returned to democracy in 1978. Despite a tenure dogged in the past two years by [USN:L1N42U0KB TEXT:"corruption investigations"], the Socialist leader is betting that the housing crisis and the prospect of a far-right party coming to power will help mobilise left-leaning voters who might have otherwise abstained. Alberto Nuñez Feijoo, former president of the region of Galicia, will run against Sanchez representing the People's Party, which he has led since April 2022. A four-time winner of presidential elections in Galicia, Feijoo built a reputation in his years governing the region as a moderate and pragmatic administrator. The PP emerged as the largest party in the 2023 general election but failed to secure enough support to form a government, leaving Feijoo as leader of the opposition. Since then, Feijoo has sought to position the PP as a government-in-waiting, piling criticism on Sanchez for everything from his policies to the corruption allegations encircling his party. A CABINET ROLE FOR THE FAR RIGHT? Polls project that the PP would rely on far-right Vox to govern, giving a far-right party a role in cabinet for the first time since the death of former dictator Francisco Franco in 1975. Its leader is Santiago Abascal, who built his political profile in the Basque Country opposing separatism and co-founded the party in 2014 alongside others defecting from or seeking an alternative to the PP. Under Abascal, Vox has evolved from a minor political force into the country's third-largest party. It advocates tougher immigration controls, recentralisation of state powers, lower taxes and the reversal of many progressive social policies. A MOBILISED LEFT? THE 'BROAD FRONT' A swathe of parties to the left of PSOE are planning to launch a new common platform called "Broad Front" (Frente Amplio), which will be Sanchez's best hope of maintaining power if it supports the Socialists in coalition as previously. The alliance would replace Sumar, a hard-left platform founded in 2023 by Labour Minister Yolanda Diaz which acted as coalition partner to Sanchez's government in his final term. The new front will name a leadership candidate at a launch event on October 17, after Diaz said she would not stand as leader again. Podemos, former junior coalition partners to PSOE who take a more critical line than Sumar, has for now refused to join the front, opting to run separately unless open primaries are held. OTHER PARTIES Spain's parliament is highly fragmented, giving minor parties that hold just a handful of seats the power to tip the scales on passing policy. The country's historically distinct regions feature four separatist parties: EH Bildu in the Basque Country, BNG in Galicia, and two in Catalonia — the left-leaning ERC and the right-leaning Junts. While EH Bildu, BNG and ERC have broadly supported Sanchez, Junts has frequently vetoed his government's measures, including the housing decrees that prompted the prime minister to dissolve parliament.

item.title: India's Godrej Consumer expects high-teens revenue growth in second quarter
item.description: India's Godrej Consumer Products said on Monday it expects second-quarter consolidated revenue to rise in the high teens, supported by growth across its businesses.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: India's Godrej Consumer Products (GOCP.NS) said on Monday it expects second-quarter consolidated revenue to rise in the high teens, supported by growth across its businesses. Here are more details: The company released its quarterly update ahead of its first earnings under Aasif Malbari as CEO and managing director after the [USN:L6N4480EV TEXT:"sudden resignation"] of long-time chief Sudhir Sitapati in August. The Goodknight mosquito repellent maker expects consolidated underlying volume for the quarter ended September 30 to grow in the high single digits and EBITDA by double digits. Godrej sees its standalone India business delivering revenue growth in the teens and underlying volume growth in the high single digits, despite a roughly 100–150 basis point hit from trade inventory correction. The Cinthol soaps maker said growth in India was supported by healthy demand across its personal care and home care portfolios. However, input cost pressures intensified during the quarter due to renewed inflation in crude-linked derivatives, palm oil and other commodity inputs, the company said. The company was countering the pressures through calibrated price increases, cost-saving measures, supply-chain efficiencies and tighter cost management, it added. The company, which is yet to announce its date to release quarterly earnings, has been in focus for its execution amid uneven demand and rising input costs. It expects its Indonesia business to post high-teens revenue growth and its Africa, USA and Middle East business to deliver robust double-digit revenue and volume growth. Godrej said it remains on track to meet its full-year outlook for fiscal 2027 and expects to exceed it in select areas.

item.title: India's fast-fashion retailer Trent reports higher quarterly revenue
item.description: Indian apparel retailer Trent reported a 23% year-on-year rise in standalone revenue for the second quarter on Monday, helped by growth across its fashion and lifestyle businesses.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Indian apparel retailer Trent (TREN.NS) reported a 23% year-on-year rise in standalone revenue for the second quarter on Monday, helped by growth across its fashion and lifestyle businesses. Here are some more details: Revenue from operations rose to 57.88 billion rupees ($601.09 million) in the July-September quarter, Trent said in an exchange filing, up from 47.24 billion rupees a year earlier The result comes as Indian consumer companies signal resilient demand On Monday, Marico (MRCO.NS) [USN:L4N45R055 TEXT:"forecast"] double-digit revenue growth and Godrej Consumer Products (GOCP.NS) said it expects revenue growth in the teens for the September quarter As of September 30, Trent operated 1,342 stores, including its Westside, Zudio and other lifestyle brands, up from 1,101 a year earlier The retailer added 17 Zudio stores and 10 Westside outlets during the quarter, compared with 40 Zudio and 13 Westside stores added a year earlier Major Indian apparel retailers have been contending with [USN:L4N44408S TEXT:"softer"] discretionary demand, with attention shifting to same-store sales performance following a prolonged period of rapid growth Trent's fashion business competes with low-cost retailers such as Vishal Mega Mart (VSSL.NS) , V-Mart Retail (VMAR.NS) , Style Bazaar and Reliance Trends, as well as premium apparel brands including Shoppers Stop and H&M Trent is the retail business of India's salt-to-steel conglomerate Tata Group ($1 = 96.2925 Indian rupees)

item.title: Medvedev é desclassificado de semifinal na China após acertar bola na torcida
item.description: Daniil Medvedev foi desclassificado das semifinais do Aberto da China contra Novak Djokovic depois de acertar uma bola na torcida, atingindo uma pessoa no olho.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Daniil Medvedev foi desclassificado das semifinais do Aberto da China contra Novak Djokovic depois de acertar uma bola na torcida, atingindo uma pessoa no olho. Medvedev, número cinco do mundo, estava perdendo a partida por 7-5 e 5-3 e havia perdido um ponto quando acertou a bola que ricocheteou na parede. O espectador, que estava sentado na primeira fileira, levou a mão ao olho esquerdo e parecia sentir dor ao sair da arquibancada, auxiliado pela equipe do estádio.

item.title: Nepal ends search and rescue after flood, focuses on rehabilitation
item.description: Nepal has ended the search and rescue operation for those still missing after the devastating flood in August that killed at least 1,455 people, officials said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Gopal Sharma
item.content:encoded: Nepal has ended the search and rescue operation for those still missing after the devastating flood in August that killed at least 1,455 people, officials said on Monday. At least 5,285 people [USN:L1N4580A2 TEXT:"were still missing"] after the August 26 flood originating at Nepal’s border with China's Tibet region. Another 13,795 people were rescued. “We are moving from the search and rescue phase to the search and rehabilitation phase,” Phanindra Paudel, chief of the National Emergency Operation Centre, told Reuters. He said authorities were considering how to legally declare the missing persons dead to allow their families or relatives to complete insurance, banking and other legal formalities. “We are initiating due processes to complete required legal formalities,” Paudel said. Dharam Raj Uprety, chief of the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority, said authorities would no longer actively search for bodies but would recover any remains, property or other valuables found during the rehabilitation process. Uprety said emergency rescues would still be carried out if needed. The flood also destroyed 12 hydroelectric projects, roads, bridges, farms and settlements. Authorities have said they need nearly $5 billion for the early recovery and rehabilitation of the thousands of people displaced by the flood.

item.title: The real reporter behind 'The Social Reckoning' on what Aaron Sorkin’s film gets right — and what it changes
item.description: Investigative reporter Jeff Horwitz discusses the surreal experience of watching his reporting with Frances Haugen get fictionalized on screen.
item.dc:creator: Jeff Horwitz, Steve Stecklow
item.content:encoded: Jeff Horwitz (Jeremy Allen White) and Frances Haugen (Mikey Madison) in Columbia Pictures’ THE SOCIAL RECKONING. Handout via REUTERS On October 4, Sony Pictures held its U.S. premiere of “The Social Reckoning,” director Aaron Sorkin’s follow-up to his 2010 Oscar-winning film “The Social Network” that dramatizes the 2021 Facebook leak by whistleblower Frances Haugen and the subsequent Wall Street Journal investigation known as “ The Facebook Files .” Reading the script was surreal for Reuters investigative reporter Jeff Horwitz, who produced the Facebook Files investigations while at the Journal and later detailed the story in his 2023 book, “ Broken Code .” The film is a fictionalized account of those real events — and while Sorkin consulted Horwitz about the project, the screenplay of which was partly based on his book, he wasn’t involved in the production and, as of this writing, hasn’t seen the film. “I’m still dealing with the weirdness of it all,” Horwitz says, noting that in early conversations about the project, Sorkin said he’d be taking some liberties with the Horwitz character, played by actor Jeremy Allen White, whom the writer-director referred to as “Movie Jeff.” Horwitz remained on the Meta beat after coming to Reuters in 2025, earning a Pulitzer Prize in beat reporting this year with colleague Engen Tham for reports that exposed how the company was knowingly allowing its chatbots to engage in harmful behavior and relying on fraudulent ads for billions of dollars in revenue. Ahead of the film’s premiere, he and his editor, Steve Stecklow, spoke about the backstory that inspired the film. This conversation has been edited and condensed for clarity. How did you meet Frances Haugen? In 2020, I was a beat reporter at the Journal covering Facebook (it later changed its name to Meta). It's a movie, so things are condensed, but source cultivation takes a long time in real life. I've found that the best sources are almost always ones that are off-the-radar, and that you have to demonstrate that you already know a great deal about a subject before they'll talk to you. Former Facebook employee and whistleblower Frances Haugen testifies during a Senate Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation hearing entitled 'Protecting Kids Online: Testimony from a Facebook Whistleblower' on Capitol Hill, in Washington, U.S., October 5, 2021. Jabin Botsford/Pool via REUTERS My initial outreach to Frances was extremely unglamorous: I sent a ton of messages via LinkedIn to members of what was then called Facebook’s “Civic Integrity Team,” which focused on curbing election misinformation. I heard back from her a few weeks later, on the day the company disbanded that team. How did those internal Facebook documents come about? Frances was a sophisticated source, and one of the first things she made clear to me was that, if she was going to be a whistleblower, she needed to be confident she would have impact. There had been some previous Facebook employees who had left the company alleging that its leadership was knowingly designing a platform that held users’ attention at the cost of spreading misinformation, polarization and hurting users' well-being. Those allegations did get attention, but the company dismissed them as coming from disgruntled former employees. Frances wanted to make sure that didn't happen, and for that she needed documentary proof. Tell me about the reporting process. How did you get the documents? How did you protect your source? Reuters reporter Jeff Horwitz. Courtesy Jeff Horwitz/Handout via REUTERS In late 2020, after Facebook disbanded the Civic Integrity team where she had worked, Frances was transferred to a new division with a whole bunch of former FBI and CIA folks. The ex-spooks were investigating governments misbehaving on Facebook, such as using the platform to try to hack or entrap political dissidents. So she was really focused on security. After our first meeting, we agreed that we should be communicating securely, so I went down to T-Mobile and bought the cheapest phone and wifi hotspot I could find, then loaned it to her. We communicated through that at first, then started meeting regularly in my backyard while she explained her general understanding of what was going on inside Facebook, how she believed the platform had set the stage for the January 6 rioting by amplifying incendiary voices, and so on. But things really accelerated only after she moved to Puerto Rico in the spring of 2021 and decided that she wanted to leave Meta. She only had a few weeks left at the company, and I went to see her in Puerto Rico. My editor initially approved a long weekend. But at the end of three days it was already very clear that there was way more interesting stuff that she could access via Facebook's internal systems than even she originally thought. Mark Zuckerberg (Jeremy Strong) in Columbia Pictures’ THE SOCIAL RECKONING. Handout via REUTERS At first, Frances was cautious about accessing anything outside of her normal wheelhouse because she assumed that Facebook had set up automated trip wires set for employees looking at things that they weren't supposed to. But as the clock ran down on her time at the company, she sort of threw caution to the wind. By the end of her employment, she was using the burner phone to take more than 1,000 pictures a day — it was physically rough on her. This was just a surreal time. I’d rented the cheapest vacation condo I could find near hers in Puerto Rico and was trying to think through how to organize the insights she was gathering while she was on Zoom work calls. I was present, just off screen, for her exit interview in which she explained to a manager that she was leaving because she’d lost faith in the company to do the right thing. What was going on inside Facebook when she decided to talk? A significant number of employees who were hired at Facebook to work on political polarization, safety and user well-being ended up becoming radicalized against the company. As they described it to me, they were told to study problems and come up with solutions. After getting real familiar with the platform's problems and identifying solutions, though, a lot of people I spoke to reported being blocked by the company from making changes due to concerns about the effects on growth and profits. So a lot of people got frustrated and quit. (Editor’s note: Meta has consistently dismissed such ex-employees’ allegations and said that it puts the interests of its users first.) So Frances wasn't unusual in her frustrations — but she was extremely smart and framed the situation well. She told me she believed Facebook was corrosive to civil society — it sort of tore down trust, and she was deeply scared that its future growth was going to come from recruiting users in some of the world's poorest places, places without internet. She was worried that people there wouldn't have built up the antibodies, so to speak, against fake news, online scams, et cetera, that those of us who grew up with the internet before smart phones had. Podcast: Listen to Jeff discuss his Facebook Files investigation and its portrayal on the big screen on the latest episode of On Assignment Was Frances always planning to become a public whistleblower? No. From the very beginning, Frances told me, she recognized that providing information to me, or anyone outside of the company, risked compromising her anonymity and her ability to find a new job in the future. She really did not want that. But Meta logs when employees view internal documents, and so there was really no chance that the company eventually wouldn’t figure out who she was after the Wall Street Journal started publishing a series based on the documents she had gathered. She was worried that Meta might take some sort of action against her — so after consulting with attorneys, she decided she’d go public shortly after the first round of stories were published. She eventually testified before Congress about what she saw. What did the Facebook Files stories show, and what was Meta’s response to the series? The documents showed that Meta had secretly exempted powerful public figures from having their posts taken down when they violated its platforms’ rules. The documents also showed that researchers had concluded Meta’s products were likely harmful to some teenagers, that the company wasn’t effectively moderating content in languages spoken by hundreds of millions of people, and that Meta had increased engagement by boosting bombastic, rage-inducing content. Meta dismissed the documents we cited in our stories as “cherry picked” and said that Haugen didn’t have relevant expertise about the topics she discussed before Congress. During an earnings call, Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg said he believed our reporting and Haugen’s public statements were “a coordinated effort to selectively use leaked documents to paint a false picture of our company.” Although Meta didn’t take legal action against Haugen, the company did some behind-the-scenes lobbying in Washington, insinuating to politicians and other journalists that there was no way one woman could have pulled this off by herself. I found the company’s suggestions that she was too polished to be authentic kind of funny, because I knew she’d had extensive training as a public speaker. Back when Frances was in school, she’d competed on and then coached national-level debate teams. What is Frances Haugen doing now and are you still in touch with her? She still lives in Puerto Rico and is now married and has a kid. She founded an organization that advocates for social-media reform and she is regularly contacted by governments interested in regulating online platforms. We don’t talk super often but we do stay in touch. Sorkin consulted with her on the movie, too. Has Meta commented on “The Social Reckoning”? A company spokesman declined to comment on the film. What was talking to Aaron Sorkin like? Writer and director Aaron Sorkin, Mikey Madison and Jeremy Allen White attend the "The Social Reckoning" gala screening in London, Britain, September 29, 2026. REUTERS/Corey Rudy This was a lot of fun, and a lot of weird. At first, Sorkin and I were just talking about my book about Meta and the Facebook Files. The book has a bit of material about the reporter-source relationship between me and Frances, but is a lot more about the company. So in my book, I'm a bit player who shows up as an observer, with most of the attention focused on the revelations from the documents and on former employees who worked on the projects that Frances ended up documenting. Did you have a role in writing the script? After Sorkin decided he wanted to see if he could make a movie about the Facebook Files, he invited me down to Los Angeles to meet and talk on several occasions. Some of the discussions centered on the specifics of Facebook’s content-recommendation systems and company culture, but a lot of his questions were about how I go about my reporting process and the details of my early meetings with Frances. I didn't see the script until after it was written. So I was more source material than collaborator. Did you expect that you were going to be a central character? Nope. When Sorkin said he was going to put my source relationship with Frances front and center, my response was, "You sure that’s a good idea?" How does it feel to be played by Jeremy Allen White? Did you meet him? Sorkin at one point asked me who I thought should play me, and I said I had no idea. When Sorkin later told me White was going to play me, I knew him from watching “The Bear” — but I was unaware that Calvin Klein had also hired him as an underwear model. So I think some artistic license may have been taken in casting. I haven’t met him. My understanding is that Sorkin told White the character of Jeff Horwitz was his to invent, which is probably for the best. France Haugen (Mikey Madison) and Jeff Horwitz (Jeremy Allen White) in Columbia Pictures' THE SOCIAL RECKONING. Handout via REUTERS Is “The Social Reckoning” true to life? When Sorkin was in the middle of writing the script, he told me that he thought he'd need to change some chronology and details to make the story he had in mind work. He also told me that he wanted to take some liberties with “Movie Jeff,” who was sort of going to be a fictionalized, investigative reporter composite. It was definitely going to be an "inspired by, not based on" situation, and Sorkin wanted to know if I was okay with that. I did appreciate him asking, and I said yes. After that, Sorkin kept the process close to the vest — it wasn't like we were discussing the storyboards or scenes or anything. I didn't see the script until it was pretty near done, and I wasn’t on the movie set during the filming. The movie touches on the question of teen well-being. How'd that come up in the documents? This wasn't something that either Frances or I initially expected we'd find. She worked on the Civic Team, which was focused on elections and society-level discourse. But obviously teenagers are a focus for Meta, so she decided she should look for anything that was teen specific. The well-being-related stuff turned out to be pretty wild and pretty detailed — I remember her stumbling onto a draft presentation on teen mental health for Mark Zuckerberg with various top lieutenants commenting on the document in the margins. Are those the documents that ended up in the recent state attorney generals’ settlements and the ongoing litigation against Meta? Some of them ended up there, absolutely. In public, the company was saying that its products were safe for children. But internally, the documents show that its researchers were concluding that, at least under some circumstances, teens were being exposed to really rough stuff on Instagram and experiencing pretty awful things. That was just what kicked off the initial investigations. The state AGs gathered their own documents, and I ended up spending the next couple of years writing about how the company's recommendation systems for content interacted with kids. The weekly rates at which teens reported they were being exposed to bullying, to self-harm content or inappropriate sexual messages from adults were really shocking. Was Frances the only source you relied on for your reporting on what Meta knew about its products' effects on teens? I found other sources who helped with that work. Some of them are public — Arturo Bejar, another whistleblower I worked with, was the lead witness in the massive state litigation against Meta that recently settled in Oakland, California. Under that deal, they’ve agreed to make some product changes and pay as much as $18 billion. (Editor’s note: Meta denied wrongdoing in agreeing to settle.) There have been plenty of other sources that have helped me but chose to stay anonymous, including the ones who provided me with internal documents that were the basis of my work at Reuters last year for which we won a Pulitzer Prize for beat reporting. Have a question for a Reuters reporter? We’ll be answering reader submissions in future editions of Reporter’s Notebook. Send yours by filling out this form .

item.title: Right-wing wave in Brazil's Congress boosts Bolsonaro camp ahead of presidential runoff
item.description: Brazil's right-wing Liberal Party, home to Senator Flavio Bolsonaro's presidential bid, emerged as the biggest winner in congressional elections on Sunday, securing the largest single-party representation in both the Senate and the lower house.
item.dc:creator: Fernando Cardoso, Ricardo Brito, Lisandra Paraguassu
item.content:encoded: Brazil's right-wing Liberal Party, home to Senator Flavio Bolsonaro's presidential bid, emerged as the biggest winner in congressional elections on Sunday, securing the largest single-party representation in both the Senate and the lower house. Senator Bolsonaro, the eldest son of former President Jair Bolsonaro, on Sunday [USN:L6N45Q04L TEXT:"won the most votes"] in the first round of the presidential race, advancing to a runoff against leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva on October 25. During the campaign, the younger Bolsonaro stumped often for allied Senate candidates. His Liberal Party (PL) increased its representation in the Senate from 15 to 28 seats, the strongest result for a party since Brazil's return to democracy in 1985. It also secured 121 seats in the lower house, projections for that chamber showed, up from 98 seats currently. Combined with other center-to-right parties and blocs, who were projected to win close to 250 seats in the lower house and more than 30 seats in the Senate, the Bolsonaro agenda looks set to enjoy a healthy working majority in the next Congress. An allied Congress - and particularly Senate - would help the younger Bolsonaro achieve his aim of granting amnesty to his father, who is serving a 27-year sentence for plotting a coup after losing the 2022 election. The Senate's pro-Bolsonaro bloc may even be close to the threshold of 54 votes needed to impeach the Supreme Court justices who convicted the far-right former leader. "I was very happy to see how many Brazilians went to the polls to make their voices heard and didn't stay on the sidelines because they want change," Bolsonaro said after the vote. Sunday's legislative races, held alongside the [USN:L6N45Q04L TEXT:"first round"] of the presidential election, renewed all 513 seats in the lower house of Congress and two-thirds of the 81-seat Senate. Congressional races in Brazil have drawn increasing voter attention in recent elections as lawmakers expand their influence in the capital Brasilia, particularly through greater control over federal spending and leverage over [USN:L1N45K0U9 TEXT:"presidential appointments"]. Lula's Workers Party (PT) also increased its footprint in Congress. The party maintained its Senate presence with nine seats, and a three-party bloc led by the PT was projected to win 88 seats in the lower house, up from 82 currently. GOVERNANCE CHALLENGES Even as Lula fights for a come-from-behind victory in the second round of voting, analysts say the next Congress would make his fourth, non-consecutive term an uphill battle. "Governance would pose a major challenge for President Lula," said Neuriberg Dias, head of legislative watchdog DIAP, adding that a right-wing bloc would work to stifle legislative progress and the functioning of government. Both political camps have illustrated the difficulties faced by presidents who do not have sufficient congressional backing. In April, Lula became the first Brazilian president in more than a century to see a Supreme Court nominee [USN:L1N41C1VC TEXT:"voted down"] amid tensions with center-right Senate President Davi Alcolumbre. Congress has also overturned dozens of Lula's vetoes since his return to office in January 2023, underscoring lawmakers' growing assertiveness. Former President Bolsonaro faced similar obstacles, with Congress blocking some of his most prominent policy initiatives, including efforts to loosen gun-control rules and introduce a printed ballot verification system for elections.

item.title: Vendas de veículos novos batem recorde em setembro com alta de 1,15% sobre agosto, diz Fenabrave
item.description: Os emplacamentos de carros, comerciais leves, caminhões e ônibus novos somaram 509.686 unidades em setembro, alta de 1,15% sobre o mês anterior, afirmou a Federação Nacional da Distribuição de Veículos Automotores (Fenabrave) nesta segunda-feira, destacando que o resultado foi o melhor para meses de setembro da série histórica.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os emplacamentos de carros, comerciais leves, caminhões e ônibus novos somaram 509.686 unidades em setembro, alta de 1,15% sobre o mês anterior, afirmou a Federação Nacional da Distribuição de Veículos Automotores (Fenabrave) nesta segunda-feira, destacando que o resultado foi o melhor para meses de setembro da série histórica. Na comparação com setembro do ano passado, os licenciamentos subiram 8,32%. Já no acumulado do ano, as vendas somaram 4,23 milhões, aumento de quase 15% ante o mesmo período no ano passado. As vendas de automóveis e comerciais leves cresceram 2,13% em relação ao mês anterior e 16,16% em relação ao ano anterior, somando 268.721. A expansão no principal segmento do setor, segundo o presidente da Fenabrave, Arcelio Junior, foi apoiada pela concorrência e por programas especiais de fomentação do setor, como o Move Brasil e Carro Sustentável. "O mercado continua demonstrando demanda por veículos novos, mesmo em um ambiente ainda complexo de crédito", destacou. A Fenabrave manteve as projeções para 2026, mas afirmou que elas poderão ser revisadas em novembro. "Os resultados atuais nos indicam um fechamento de ano melhor do que o esperado, para a maior parte dos segmentos, mas vamos aguardar o desempenho de outubro, que pode apontar ajustes no mercado", acrescentou Arcelio Junior.

item.title: Medvedev, descalificado en semifinales del Abierto de China tras dar un pelotazo a un espectador
item.description: Daniil Medvedev fue descalificado de su partido de semifinales del Abierto de China contra Novak Djokovic tras lanzar con fuerza hacia el público una pelota, la cual golpeó a un espectador en el ojo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Daniil Medvedev fue descalificado de su partido de semifinales del Abierto de China contra Novak Djokovic tras lanzar con fuerza hacia el público una pelota, la cual golpeó a un espectador en el ojo. El tenista ruso, número cinco del mundo, iba perdiendo el partido por 7-5 y 5-3 y acababa de ceder un punto cuando golpeó una pelota que le llegó rebotada de la pared. El espectador, que estaba sentado en la primera fila, se llevó la mano al ojo izquierdo y se mostró dolorido mientras abandonaba la grada ayudado por el personal del estadio.

item.title: Man who planned attack on Israeli embassy in London jailed for at least 20 years
item.description: A Kuwaiti man who tried to enter Israel's embassy in London armed with two knives and carrying a "martyrdom note" was sentenced to life in prison on Monday with a minimum term of 20 years after being convicted of preparing an act of terrorism.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Kuwaiti man who tried to enter Israel's embassy in London armed with two knives and carrying a "martyrdom note" was sentenced to life in prison on Monday with a minimum term of 20 years after being convicted of preparing an act of terrorism. Abdullah Albadri, 34, attempted to [USN:L8N41C1Q3 TEXT:"breach the embassy's perimeter"] in west London in April 2025 before being stopped by armed police officers guarding the site. Prosecutors said Albadri wanted to attack the embassy in revenge for Israel's actions in Gaza. Evidence presented at trial showed he had researched the embassy's location, carried two knives and was in possession of a note indicating his intention to die as a martyr. A jury at London's Old Bailey found him guilty in May of preparing an act of terrorism and possessing two bladed articles. He was given a life sentence with a minimum term of 20 years for the terrorism offence.

item.title: Huawei fecha acordo plurianual de licenciamento de patentes com Qualcomm
item.description: A chinesa Huawei Technologies (HWT.UL) anunciou nesta segunda-feira que fechou um amplo acordo plurianual de licença de patentes com a Qualcomm , abrangendo tecnologias de inteligência artificial, 5G, computação e redes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A chinesa Huawei Technologies (HWT.UL) anunciou nesta segunda-feira que fechou um amplo acordo plurianual de licença de patentes com a Qualcomm (QCOM.O) , abrangendo tecnologias de inteligência artificial, 5G, computação e redes. O acordo inclui a aquisição, pela Qualcomm, de determinadas patentes da Huawei nos Estados Unidos relacionadas à computação, IA e redes, informou a Huawei em comunicado. Este é o primeiro acordo de licenciamento de patentes da Huawei com a Qualcomm que abrange tecnologias 5G. A Huawei afirmou que o acordo deve elevar o valor total de seus contratos de licenciamento de patentes para mais de US$6,9 bilhões, uma vez concluído. A empresa afirmou que seu negócio de licenciamento de propriedade intelectual vem gerando receita positiva desde 2021, refletindo anos de pesados investimentos em pesquisa e desenvolvimento. A Huawei intensificou seus gastos com pesquisa e desenvolvimento nos últimos anos, já que as restrições comerciais dos Estados Unidos, em vigor desde 2019, limitaram sua capacidade de adquirir chips avançados e softwares essenciais. A Huawei efetuou seu primeiro pagamento de royalties à Qualcomm em 2001, enquanto recebeu sua primeira receita de licenciamento em 2011 da Motorola. O acordo com a Qualcomm segue-se a um contrato de licenciamento com a HP. (HPQ.N) anunciado pela Huawei em agosto. (Reportagem de Miyoung Kim)

item.title: La actividad de servicios de EEUU se ralentiza en septiembre y suben las presiones de precios
item.description: La actividad del sector servicios de Estados Unidos se ralentizó en septiembre, ya que la fuerte demanda interna ejerció presión sobre las cadenas de suministro y provocó un alza de los precios que pagan las empresas por sus insumos, lo que indica que la inflación podría mantenerse alta hasta el año que viene.
item.dc:creator: Lucia Mutikani
item.content:encoded: La actividad del sector servicios de Estados Unidos se ralentizó en septiembre, ya que la fuerte demanda interna ejerció presión sobre las cadenas de suministro y provocó un alza de los precios que pagan las empresas por sus insumos, lo que indica que la inflación podría mantenerse alta hasta el año que viene. El Instituto de Gerencia y Abastecimiento comunicó el lunes que su índice de gestores de compras (PMI) no manufacturero bajó el mes pasado al 54,9, desde el 55,4 de agosto. Una lectura superior a 50 indica crecimiento en el sector de los servicios, que representa más de dos tercios de la actividad económica de Estados Unidos. Los economistas encuestados por Reuters habían pronosticado que el PMI se mantendría prácticamente sin cambios, en 55,2. El PMI está en línea con el fuerte crecimiento económico del tercer trimestre. La economía se ve impulsada por una sólida demanda interna, principalmente por el gasto de los consumidores y las inversiones de las empresas en inteligencia artificial e infraestructuras relacionadas. El indicador de la encuesta relativo a los nuevos pedidos recibidos por las empresas de servicios se moderó a 59,8 el mes pasado, tras dispararse hasta 60,9 en agosto, que fue la lectura más alta desde febrero de 2023. Las cadenas de suministro tienen dificultades para hacer frente a la fuerte demanda, una situación que se ha visto agravada por la guerra de Estados Unidos e Israel contra Irán. El conflicto de Oriente Medio ha provocado un aumento de los precios de la energía y ha causado escasez de materias primas que se transportan a través del estrecho de Ormuz. Los precios del gasóleo se encuentran en máximos históricos y podrían empezar a ejercer presión en otros sectores además del transporte y la agricultura, advirtieron los economistas. El indicador de la encuesta relativo a los precios pagados por las empresas por los insumos se disparó a 74,0, desde el 72,6 de agosto, un aumento similar en la encuesta manufacturera del ISM.

item.title: BIS chief warns soaring debt, market changes could complicate future crisis response
item.description: Central banks will remain at the heart of managing future financial crises, but rising public debt and other key changes could make their task more difficult and controversial, the head of the Bank for International Settlements (BIS) said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Marc Jones
item.content:encoded: Central banks will remain at the heart of managing future financial crises, but rising public debt and other key changes could make their task more difficult and controversial, the head of the Bank for International Settlements (BIS) said on Monday. Speaking in Vienna, Pablo Hernández de Cos - one of the frontrunners to take over from Christine Lagarde as European Central Bank President next year, said the run of crises over the last 20 years had demonstrated the importance of swift central bank action in quelling market turmoil. However, he said the backdrop for the next crisis was changing rapidly. Public debt levels are near post-World War Two highs in many economies, while budget deficits remain large and fiscal pressures are expected to persist. That could make it harder for central banks to distinguish between market dysfunction requiring intervention and legitimate investor concerns over government finances. "If market dysfunction threatens financial stability or monetary transmission, central banks need to intervene," Hernández de Cos said. "But when debt is high and public financing needs are large, even a well-designed operation can be interpreted through a fiscal lens". CRISIS-MANAGEMENT TOOLS The BIS chief's warnings come amid a sharp recent rise in bond yields globally and as an [USN:L8N45O0YO TEXT:"explosion"] of the 'spread' - or gap - between French yields and those of triple-A rated Germany , stirs memories of the euro crisis. Hernández de Cos also highlighted the growing influence of so-called 'non-bank financial institutions' such as hedge funds, pension funds and asset managers, which have become major holders of government debt. While they support market liquidity in normal times, their use of leverage and market-based funding can amplify stress during periods of turmoil, he said, pointing to the March 2020 "dash for cash" in US Treasury markets and Britain's 2022 gilt market crisis as evidence. He said the Bank of England’s response "offers a blueprint" for how central banks should use asset purchases as a crisis-fighting tool. Strictly limited purchase windows and amounts as well as clear communication and governance mechanisms worked well, he said, although he also warned that in a bigger and more persistent crisis, "such commitment might not be credible". He added that online banking, social media, stablecoins and AI could all increase the speed of future crises. Rapid online withdrawals and the fast spread of information, including misinformation, could force policymakers to respond more quickly than in the past. He argued that stronger regulation of non-banks and emerging financial technologies would be needed to limit moral hazard and preserve the effectiveness of central bank crisis-management tools. "Central banks have a key role to play, but so do regulators and governments," Hernández de Cos said, adding that "global cooperation" also remained crucial. "Central bank swap lines remain critical to stabilise the global financial system at times of acute distress."

item.title: Reclusas en Perú elaboran muñecos del papa León XIV antes de la visita del pontífice
item.description: Detrás de las rejas de metal de la prisión femenina de la capital de Perú, el rítmico traqueteo de las máquinas de coser y el chasquido de las tijeras marcan una carrera contra el tiempo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Detrás de las rejas de metal de la prisión femenina de la capital de Perú, el rítmico traqueteo de las máquinas de coser y el chasquido de las tijeras marcan una carrera contra el tiempo. Las reclusas del penal Mujeres de Chorrillos elaboran peluches de terciopelo, llaveros, collares y otros suvenires, todos con la imagen del papa León XIV, quien llegará al país andino en su primera gira por Sudamérica en noviembre. Como parte de un programa de "cárceles productivas", las internas tienen como objetivo financiar su reinserción a la sociedad en medio de un entusiasmo por la visita del Sumo Pontífice, que nació en Estados Unidos, pero que sirvió como religioso en Perú durante décadas y adoptó la ciudadanía peruana. "En esta oportunidad estamos en el modo Papa, papa León XIV", dijo Nanny, una interna que pidió no mencionar su apellido, mientras con tijera en mano daba forma al rostro del peluche. "El año pasado supimos que el papa tenía su documento de identidad peruano y lanzamos la idea de hacer un muñequito, para todo tipo de edad, tanto para niños como para adultos". En medio de máquinas de coser y retazos de tela, algunas internas arman los muñecos colocándoles una cruz en el "pecho" y una solapa roja, como la indumentaria del Sumo Pontífice. Otras fabrican además aretes y pulseras con el rostro del Papa. "Perdemos directamente el contacto personal con nuestra familia, con nuestros hijos, que son los que mas sufren", dijo Nanny. "De repente no estamos en cuerpo (con sus parientes), pero si estamos en alma, en corazón", agregó. Para las mujeres, el trabajo les brinda un escape mental y una forma de apoyar a sus familias desde la distancia. Judit Vargas, una colombiana encarcelada por seis años, dice que el taller es un tubo de escape. "Para mí este es un beneficio muy grande porque me distrae, me hace aprender muchas cosas". Robert Prevost, el nombre secular del papa León XIV, llegó por primera vez a Perú en 1985, enviado como misionero a un pequeño pueblo del norte del país. En 2015 se nacionalizó peruano luego de ser nombrado obispo de Chiclayo, donde sirvió hasta 2023, cuando el entonces papa Francisco lo convocó a Roma para dirigir una oficina clave del Vaticano antes de nombrarlo cardenal. La directora del penal, Doris Nakandakari, dijo que en el taller trabajan 78 internas en las manualidades que se venden por servicio de entrega o en una tienda fuera del penal. Los muñecos tienen un precio equivalente a nueve dólares cada uno. Nakandakari dijo que aunque el programa enseña habilidades vocacionales, las internas esperan una recompensa espiritual. "Su mayor anhelo es que el Papa las visite y ellas, como madres, como personas (...) quieren que el Papa les dé su bendición y que les ayude a darles esos ánimos de seguir adelante". El papa León XIV, de 71 años, estará entre el 11 y 16 de noviembre en Perú, en su última parada tras visitar previamente Argentina y Uruguay como parte de su gira por la región.

item.title: Nvidia, Broadcom shielded as AI power crunch hits chip supply chain, says Morgan Stanley
item.description: Nvidia and Broadcom are relatively insulated from a worsening US data-center power crunch, but any resultant delay in AI deployments can affect makers of memory, optical and other secondary chip components, Morgan Stanley said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Nvidia (NVDA.O) and Broadcom (AVGO.O) are relatively insulated from a worsening US data-center power crunch, but any resultant delay in AI deployments can affect makers of memory, optical and other secondary chip components, Morgan Stanley said on Monday. The brokerage estimated last month that US data-center developers face a 34% net power shortfall through 2028, equivalent to 32 GW, after accounting for measures such as behind-the-meter generation and fuel cells The AI boom has triggered billions of dollars in data-center investment, but the vast computing and electricity needs of generative AI are increasingly running up against US power supply issues Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs have both flagged mounting constraints on the US data-center buildout; GS expects limited near-term impact from political pushback, while MS sees labor, power and political challenges Morgan Stanley said it does not see the bottlenecks putting Nvidia or Broadcom's 2027 forecasts at risk, citing their visibility into chip placement, geographic expansion and coordination between data centers, semiconductor suppliers and the power supply chain If chip capacity cannot be deployed, customers could push out deliveries or cancel orders, with memory, optics, power-management and analog components most exposed to inventory disruption, the brokerage said

item.title: Atividade do setor de serviços dos EUA desacelera em setembro; pressões sobre preços aumentam
item.description: A atividade no setor de serviços dos Estados Unidos desacelerou em setembro, com a forte demanda interna sobrecarregando as cadeias de oferta e elevando os preços pagos pelas empresas pelos insumos, o que indica que a inflação poderá permanecer alta até o ano que vem.
item.dc:creator: Lucia Mutikani
item.content:encoded: A atividade no setor de serviços dos Estados Unidos desacelerou em setembro, com a forte demanda interna sobrecarregando as cadeias de oferta e elevando os preços pagos pelas empresas pelos insumos, o que indica que a inflação poderá permanecer alta até o ano que vem. O Instituto de Gestão de Fornecimento (ISM) informou nesta segunda-feira que seu Índice de Gerentes de Compras (PMI) do setor não manufatureiro caiu para 54,9 no mês passado, ante 55,4 em agosto. Leitura acima de 50 indica crescimento no setor de serviços, que responde por mais de dois terços da atividade econômica dos EUA. Economistas consultados pela Reuters previam que o PMI ficaria em 55,2. O PMI se manteve consistente com o forte crescimento econômico no terceiro trimestre. A economia está sendo impulsionada por uma demanda interna robusta, principalmente pelos gastos dos consumidores e pelos investimentos das empresas em IA e infraestrutura relacionada. O indicador da pesquisa referente a novos pedidos recebidos por empresas de serviços recuou para 59,8 no mês passado, após atingir 60,9 em agosto — o maior valor registrado desde fevereiro de 2023. As cadeias de oferta enfrentam dificuldades para lidar com a forte demanda, situação agravada pela guerra dos EUA e de Israel contra o Irã. O conflito no Oriente Médio elevou os preços da energia e causou escassez de commodities transportadas pelo Estreito de Ormuz. Os preços do diesel estão em níveis recordes e podem começar a exercer pressão além dos setores de transporte e agricultura, alertaram economistas. O indicador da pesquisa referente aos preços pagos pelas empresas pelos insumos saltou de 72,6 em agosto para 74,0. Isso refletiu um aumento semelhante na pesquisa de manufatura do ISM. Juntas, as duas pesquisas apontaram para uma inflação mais alta no futuro e reforçaram as expectativas dos economistas de que o Federal Reserve aumentará a taxa de juros em dezembro. No mês passado, o Fed elevou sua taxa básica de juros em 25 pontos-base, para a faixa de 3,75% a 4,00% — o primeiro aumento em três anos — e sinalizou novas altas nos custos de financiamento no futuro. As chances de um aumento da taxa neste mês foram reduzidas pelos dados de inflação mais baixos do que o esperado para agosto e julho, bem como por uma forte desaceleração na criação de vagas de trabalho fora do setor agrícola em setembro. (Reportagem de Lucia Mutikani)

item.title: Medvedev disqualified from China Open semi after injuring spectator with ball
item.description: Russian Daniil Medvedev was disqualified from his China Open semi-final clash with Novak Djokovic after hitting a rebounding ball into the crowd, striking a spectator in the eye.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Russian Daniil Medvedev was disqualified from his China Open semi-final clash with Novak Djokovic after hitting a rebounding ball into the crowd, striking a spectator in the eye. World number five Medvedev was trailing 7-5 5-3 on Monday and had lost a point when he hit the ball coming off the wall. The spectator, who was sitting in the first row behind Medvedev, clutched his left eye and appeared to be in pain as he walked out of the gallery, assisted by stadium staff. Medvedev did not protest the umpire's decision to disqualify him. The Russian will lose his points and prize money from the tournament as a result of the default. "Terribly sorry to the spectator, first of all," Medvedev told reporters." I'm trying to get in touch with him, if he wants it. Hopefully I can apologise in person and see how he feels." The 30-year-old former US Open champion said he did not cause the incident intentionally. "The ball was bouncing back, so I tried to, like, just hit it anywhere, so it doesn't go out from the court. When I saw the result, I mean, I felt horrible because, again, I don't think I was ever close to such a situation." Sixth seed Djokovic said he was shocked by the incident. "I hope that person is not badly injured," said Djokovic, who was disqualified from the US Open in 2020 in similar circumstances. "On the other hand, I also feel sorry for Daniil because I know exactly how it feels to be disqualified in a big match." Both semi-finals ended prematurely in Beijing as Hubert Hurkacz retired with an adductor injury earlier in the day. Australian Alex de Minaur was leading the first semi 6-4 3-2 when his Polish opponent, who had struggled with movement throughout the match, retired. 'GRUELLING BATTLE' Djokovic's win extended his China Open record to 33 victories without a loss, extending his record of making the best start in a men's singles tournament in the Open Era. The Serbian beat French and U.S. Open champion Alexander Zverev [USN:L6N45Q056 TEXT:"in the quarter-finals"] to break the record Rafael Nadal set by winning his first 31 matches at Roland Garros. Djokovic, 39, survived punishing long rallies and saved seven break points to take the first set in one hour and 19 minutes. He was serving for the match when Medvedev was disqualified.
