"It was a gruelling battle ... it always is a big battle with Daniil and it's so hard to play him," said Djokovic, who won the tournament all six times he played in it from 2009 to 2015 before returning to the event this year. "Another final. There's something about Beijing that just keeps me going."

item.title: צעקות נערכו לתוך סרטון ממטוס והוצגו באופן מטעה כתיעוד התקרית בטיסת פליי דובאי
item.description: הקלטה של אנשים צורחים נערכה לתוך סרטון לא קשור של מטוס ופורסמה ברשת עם כיתובים שקריים המתארים אותה כתיעוד של התקרית שהתרחשה ב-30 בספטמבר, בטיסת פליי דובאי מדובאי לתל אביב.
item.dc:creator: בדיקת עובדות רויטרס
item.content:encoded: הקלטה של אנשים צורחים נערכה לתוך סרטון לא קשור של מטוס ופורסמה ברשת עם כיתובים שקריים המתארים אותה כתיעוד של [USN:S8N44D013 TEXT:"התקרית"] שהתרחשה ב-30 בספטמבר, בטיסת פליי דובאי מדובאי לתל אביב. להלן העובדות המרכזיות: הסרטון הערוך פורסם ברשת ביום רביעי עם כיתוב המציג אותו כ"תיעוד של תמונת מצב מטיסת פליי דובאי". שעות לפני פרסום הסרטון הערוך, רויטרס דיווחה כי טיסת FZ1073 של פליי דובאי הוסטה לסעודיה בעקבות תקרית שהתרחשה במטוס. גורמים ישראליים [USN:S8N44D013 TEXT:"מסרו"] מאוחר יותר כי טייס המשנה דקר את הקברניט בניסיון לגרום להתרסקות המטוס, אך נוסעים ואנשי צוות השתלטו עליו. הסרטון ברשת הוא מטיסת פליי דובאי אחרת שאינה קשורה לתקרית. לפי ניתוח רויטרס של תצלומי לוויין של גוגל, המטוס בסרטון טס לאורך חופי איחוד האמירויות בדרכו לנמל התעופה הבינלאומי של דובאי. נתונים מאתר מעקב הטיסות FlightRadar24 מראים כי FZ1073 טסה בכיוון ההפוך למטוס שנראה בסרטון, נכנסה לזמן קצר למרחב האווירי של ירדן, במרחק של כמעט 2,000 ק"מ מדובאי, ולאחר מכן הוסטה לסעודיה. האודיו של האנשים הצורחים נלקח מסרטון אחר, שאינו קשור לאירוע, ושפורסם בטיקטוק ביוני 2022, יותר מארבע שנים לפני התקרית ב-30 בספטמבר. רויטרס מצאה התאמה בין המאפיינים הגאוגרפיים הנראו בסרטון הטיקטוק לתצלומי לוויין של גוגל של אושויה, ארגנטינה. משתמש הטיקטוק, די-ג'יי ארגנטינאי בשם ניקו ואלוראני, כתב בפוסט כי צילם את הסרטון במהלך טיסה לאושואיה, וכי האנשים צרחו בזמן שהמטוס עבר במערבולת אוויר. ואלוראני לא השיב לבקשת רויטרס לתגובה. ניתוח באמצעות כלי האימות של פלטפורמות מטא, שמזהה סימני מים בלתי נראים שהוטמעו בתוכן שנוצר, קבע כי ככל הנראה הסרטון המזויף עבר עריכה באמצעות מודלי הבינה המלאכותית של החברה. פסק דין: שונה. האודיו והסרטון נערכו יחד משני מקורות נפרדים, ואף אחד מהם אינו מציג את התקרית שהתרחשה בטיסה FZ1073 ב-30 בספטמבר. מאמר זה הופק על ידי צוות בדיקת העובדות של רויטרס. קראו עוד על עבודת בדיקת העובדות שלנו.

item.title: US services sector activity slows in September; price pressures mount
item.description: US services sector activity slowed in September, with strong domestic demand stretching supply chains and raising prices paid by businesses for inputs, indicating that inflation could remain high into next year.
item.dc:creator: Lucia Mutikani
item.content:encoded: US services sector activity slowed in September, with strong domestic demand stretching supply chains and raising prices paid by businesses for inputs, indicating that inflation could remain high into next year. The Institute for Supply Management said on Monday its nonmanufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index fell to 54.9 last month from 55.4 in August. A reading above 50 indicates growth in the services sector, which accounts for more than two-thirds of US economic activity. Economists polled by Reuters had forecast the PMI little changed at 55.2. The PMI remained consistent with strong economic growth in the third quarter. The economy is being driven by robust [USN:L1N45L0XU TEXT:"domestic demand"], mostly consumer spending and businesses investing in AI and related infrastructure. The survey's measure of new orders received by services businesses eased to 59.8 last month after surging to 60.9 in August, which was the highest reading since February 2023. Supply chains are struggling to cope with the strong demand, a situation that has been worsened by the US-Israel war with Iran. The Middle East conflict has raised energy prices and caused shortages of commodities that are shipped through the Strait of Hormuz. Diesel prices are at record highs and could start to exert pressure beyond the transportation and agricultural sectors, economists warned. The survey's measure of supplier deliveries increased to 53.2 from 51.3 in August. A reading above 50 indicates slower deliveries. That measure has slowed for 22 consecutive months, boosting input prices. Supplier delivery performance was initially impacted by tariffs on imports. The survey's measure of prices paid by businesses for inputs jumped to 74.0 from 72.6 in August. It mirrored a similar increase in the ISM's manufacturing survey. Combined, the two surveys pointed to higher inflation down the road and supported economists' expectations that the Federal Reserve would raise interest rates in December. The Fed last month raised its benchmark overnight interest rate by 25 basis points to the 3.75%-4.00% range, the first hike in three years, and flagged further increases in borrowing costs ahead. The chances of a rate hike this month were diminished by cooler-than-expected [USN:L1N45M0L0 TEXT:"inflation readings"] for August and July as well as a sharp slowdown in [USN:L1N45N170 TEXT:"nonfarm payroll growth"] in September. The ISM survey showed a rise in services sector employment. That, together with an increase in [USN:L1N45M123 TEXT:"manufacturing employment "]reported by the ISM last week, supported economists' assessment that the labor market remained stable despite September's underwhelming payroll gains. The survey's measure of services employment climbed to 50.1 from 47.8 in August.

item.title: 米サービス部門ＰＭＩ、9月は54.9に低下 物価上昇圧力増す
item.description:
Lucia Mutikani
[ワシントン ５日 ロイター] - 米供給管理協会（ＩＳＭ）が５日発表した９月の非製造業...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米サービス部門ＰＭＩ、9月は54.9に低下　物価上昇圧力増す 10/5 23:03 配信

米カリフォルニア州ロサンゼルスのレストランで３月撮影。REUTERS/ Mike Blake

Lucia Mutikani

[ワシントン ５日 ロイター] - 米供給管理協会（ＩＳＭ）が５日発表した９月の非製造業購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）は５４．９と、８月の５５．４から低下した。国内需要の強さがサプライチェーン（供給網）を圧迫し、企業が投入物に対して支払う価格を上昇させたため、インフレ率は来年も高止まりする可能性がある。

非製造業ＰＭＩは５０を上回ればサービス部門の景況拡大を、下回れば悪化を示す。エコノミストはほぼ横ばいの５５．２になると予想していた。

ＰＭＩは引き続き第３・四半期の堅調な経済成長を示した。経済は主に個人消費とＡＩ（人工知能）および関連インフラへの企業投資といった、力強い国内需要にけん引されている。

サービス業の新規受注指数は、８月に６０．９まで急上昇し、２０２３年２月以来の高水準を記録した後、９月は５９．８に低下した。

サプライヤーの納入状況を示す指数は８月の５１．３から５３．２に上昇。５０を超える数値は納入の遅延を示している。この指標は２２カ月連続で納入の遅れを示しており、投入価格の上昇につながっている。

企業が投入財に支払う価格を示す指数は、８月の７２．６から７４．０に上昇。ＩＳＭ製造業指数における同様の上昇を反映している。これら２つの調査結果を合わせると、今後のインフレ率上昇を示唆しており、連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が１２月に利上げを行うというエコノミスト予想を裏付けるものとなった。

雇用が増加し、指数は８月の４７．８から５０．１に上昇した。これは、ＩＳＭが発表した製造業の雇用増加と合わせて、９月の雇用統計が予想を下回ったにもかかわらず、労働市場は安定しているというエコノミストの見解を裏付けるものとなった。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：米景気拡大維持、ＦＲＢの利下げペース次第 アングル：米長期金利5％接近で株式市場に警戒感、決算後はマクロ要因に注目 焦点：ベセント氏発言で強まる日銀9月利上げ観測、米国の影響力拡大に懸念も アングル：米国債「ツイスト・スティープ化」、ＦＲＢの信認巡る懸念反映か アングル：インフレで揺らぐ債券のヘッジ機能、米投資家は実物資産に移行 最終更新: 10/5(月) 23:03 ロイター

item.title: Nigeria military helicopter crashes with 32 aboard, rescue operations ongoing
item.description: A Nigerian military aircraft carrying 25 passengers and seven crew members crashed near a naval base in southwestern Ondo state after losing contact with air traffic control while en route to Lagos, the aviation minister said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Macdonald Dzirutwe
item.content:encoded: A Nigerian military aircraft carrying 25 passengers and seven crew members crashed near a naval base in southwestern Ondo state after losing contact with air traffic control while en route to Lagos, the aviation minister said on Monday. The minister, Festus Keyamo, said in a statement that controllers lost contact with the aircraft at 0813 GMT and were unable to re-establish communication before its disappearance was reported. The wreckage was later located near a naval base in the coastal town of Igbokoda, and search and rescue operations were underway, he said. There was no immediate confirmation of casualties from the crash. The crash is one of Nigeria's worst military aviation accidents in recent years and is likely to intensify scrutiny of flight safety and operational readiness as authorities investigate the cause.

item.title: UK grocer Sainsbury's held merger talks with rival Morrisons, reports say
item.description: Sainsbury's , Britain's second-largest grocer, held talks with smaller rival Morrisons about a merger earlier this year, according to media reports on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Sainsbury's (SBRY.L) , Britain's second-largest grocer, held talks with smaller rival Morrisons about a merger earlier this year, according to media reports on Monday. The companies were considering a potential multibillion-pound deal before Sainsbury's walked away, an FT report said, citing people familiar with the matter The talks took place between November 2025 and February this year, the FT report said, adding that talks are no longer active People close to the situation did not rule out negotiations restarting in the future, the FT report said Spokespeople for both Sainsbury's and US private equity firm-owned Morrisons declined to comment on the report While Sainsbury's reported [USN:L8N43209G TEXT:"slower underlying sales growth"] in its most recent quarter, Morrisons, the UK's [USN:L8N4560GY TEXT:"sixth-largest grocer"], reported [USN:L8N4580LA TEXT:"growth in quarterly sales"] In 2019, Britain's competition regulator blocked Sainsbury's proposed £7.3 billion takeover of Asda Morrisons' owner, private equity firm Clayton Dubilier & Rice, would remain open to a tie-up with one of its competitors, Sky News reported , citing retail insiders Clayton, Dubilier & Rice won an [USN:S8N2M705J TEXT:"auction"] to buy Morrisons for £7 billion in 2021, beating a consortium led by SoftBank (9434.T) -owned Fortress Investment Group Shares of Sainsbury's were little changed on Monday and marginally down so far this year

item.title: ICC provides more details on arrest warrants for two Taliban leaders
item.description: The International Criminal Court provided more details on Monday on arrest warrants issued last year for two Taliban leaders, Haibatullah Akhundzada, the group's supreme spiritual leader, and Abdul Hakim Haqqani, who has been chief justice since 2021.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The International Criminal Court provided more details on Monday on arrest warrants issued last year for two Taliban leaders, Haibatullah Akhundzada, the group's supreme spiritual leader, and Abdul Hakim Haqqani, who has been chief justice since 2021. The ICC had already [USN:L6N3T50OL TEXT:"announced"] the existence of the warrants in July 2025, saying the men were accused of committing the crime against humanity of persecution on gender grounds against girls, women and other people who did not conform with the Taliban's policy on gender, gender identity or expression. The precise contents of the warrants had remained sealed. Now the court has given more information about the findings of the judges who issued the warrants. They found the suspects "implemented a governmental policy that resulted in severe violations of fundamental rights and freedoms of the civilian population of Afghanistan, in connection with conducts of murder, imprisonment, torture, rape and enforced disappearance". While the Taliban have imposed strict rules and prohibitions on the entire Afghan population, they have specifically targeted women and girls by denying them the right to education, freedom of expression and freedom of movement, the judges found. According to UN figures, half of Afghan women now leave their homes only once or twice a month as Taliban-imposed restrictions curtail their freedom of movement and participation in public life. Afghanistan remains the only country in the world to ban girls from secondary education and women from attending university, said UN Women, which promotes gender equality.

item.title: ロシアのハイブリッド攻撃急増、欧州全域で人命脅かす＝ＥＵ外相
item.description: [ブリュッセル ５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ブリュッセル　５日　ロイター] - 欧州連合（ＥＵ）のカラス外交安全保障上級代表（外相）は５日、ロシアがハイブリッド攻撃により欧州全域で人々の命を危険にさらしていると述べた。モルドバのトファン首相との共同記者会見で語った。

カラス氏はブリュッセルで記者団に対し「欧州ではここ数週間、ロシアによるハイブリッド攻撃や破壊工作の試み、領空侵犯が急増している」と指摘。「週末にはロシアのミサイルとドローン（無人機）が再びモルドバの領空を侵犯した。これは全く容認できない」と述べた。

ロシアは９月３０日、広く予想されていたウクライナの電力網への大規模な航空攻撃に踏み切り、首都キーウ周辺や各地の発電施設やインフラを攻撃。エネルギー関連施設に対する複合攻撃としてはここ数カ月で最大規模となった。ウクライナ西側の国境に接するモルドバでは、同日中に３機のドローンが領空に侵入したと国防省が明らかにした。

ドイツのメルツ首相も１日、ドイツはロシアからの「深刻なものも含むさらなるハイブリッド攻撃に備えている」と訴えた上で、ロシアに侵攻されたウクライナへの支援継続を約束すると述べた。

item.title: US Supreme Court won't hear Zillow's bid to escape investor class action
item.description: The US Supreme Court declined on Monday to hear a bid by real estate platform Zillow Group to escape a class action that accused it of misleading investors about its failed home-flipping venture.
item.dc:creator: Jan Wolfe
item.content:encoded: The US Supreme Court declined on Monday to hear a bid by real estate platform Zillow Group (ZG.O) to escape a class action that accused it of misleading investors about its failed home-flipping venture. The court turned away Seattle-based Zillow's appeal of a lower court's decision that allowed the 2021 lawsuit to move forward in federal court in Washington state. At issue in the case is what defenses publicly traded companies can raise in lawsuits alleging they made false statements to the investing public. In such class actions, which are common in US courts, plaintiffs' lawyers frequently allege that companies made misrepresentations designed not to actively drive up their stock price, but simply to keep it from falling. The Zillow dispute is an example of one of these cases, known as "price-maintenance" cases. Zillow's stock plunged in November 2021 because the company announced it was permanently shutting down Zillow Offers, its home-flipping division, after management admitted it could not accurately forecast future home prices. The company disclosed that it wrote down $300 million in losses during the previous quarter and announced a layoff of 25% of its workforce. Investors sued in federal court, saying statements made by Zillow's then-CEO and other company leaders in the preceding months painted an overly positive picture of the business unit. Zillow's lawyers denied that the company had engaged in securities fraud. "Zillow made a business decision to enter a new line of business, disclosing all of the risk in doing so, that in the end simply did not work out as the company had hoped," Zillow's lawyers said in a court filing. The San Francisco-based 9th US Circuit Court of Appeals last year upheld a judge's decision that allowed the case to move forward as a class action. The disclosures Zillow made in November 2021 "revealed new information about how Zillow's home-pricing struggles threatened the business and suggested that its earlier statements may have obscured how Zillow's pricing model misfired," the 9th Circuit said. In a filing asking the Supreme Court to hear its appeal, Zillow said the justices should clear up a split in federal appellate courts over how closely related a company's back-end corrective disclosures, which trigger a stock drop, must be to earlier alleged misstatements to justify certifying a class action. Pro-business lobbying groups including the US Chamber of Commerce have criticized the 9th Circuit decision, saying in a filing that this ruling deviated from Supreme Court precedent and "would expose American businesses to costly securities class-action lawsuits."

item.title: Private credit roundup: Blue Owl redemptions ease, tech and refinancing risks persist
item.description: Withdrawal requests at Blue Owl Capital's flagship non-traded private credit fund dropped again in the third quarter, signalling redemption pressure is easing across parts of the US market even as stress remains in some vehicles and refinancing risks loom.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Withdrawal requests at [USN:L4N45N1AV TEXT:"Blue Owl Capital's"] (OWL.N) flagship non-traded private credit fund dropped again in the third quarter, signalling redemption pressure is easing across parts of the US market even as stress remains in some vehicles and refinancing risks loom. Investors sought to withdraw $4.2 billion from Blue Owl's two non-traded private credit funds in the quarter, down from $4.7 billion in the second quarter and a record $5.4 billion in the first. Requests at the $35.1 billion Blue Owl Credit Income Corp., or OCIC, fell to 16.8% of shares from 18.8%. Blue Owl said most requests reflected investors resubmitting previously unfulfilled tenders rather than new withdrawal demand. The picture was weaker at technology-focused Blue Owl Technology Income Corp., or OTIC, where investors sought to withdraw $1.1 billion, equal to 39% of shares, up from 38.1% in the prior quarter. The broader direction in the United States nonetheless appears more encouraging. Goldman Sachs' (GS.N) $18.2 billion GS Credit fund reported [USN:L4N45L1ZS TEXT:"redemption requests"] equal to 2% of shares, down from 3.2% in the second quarter, while generating about $400 million of gross inflows. Evercore analyst Glenn Schorr said the more persistent challenge for non-traded business development companies (BDCs) may now be weak new subscriptions, as direct lending could take time to regain favour among wealth-management clients and advisers. Outside the US, however, liquidity stress has intensified. Australia's Metrics Credit Partners, which manages about A$40 billion ($28 billion), froze [USN:L6N45M076 TEXT:"redemptions"] in some unlisted funds after auditor KPMG declined to sign off on annual accounts for three listed vehicles. Metrics said KPMG disagreed with assumptions in preliminary financial statements, including the valuation of unlisted commercial real-estate equity investments. Australia's corporate regulator said it was closely monitoring the sector after previously warning about valuation, liquidity, governance and transparency practices. Even as redemption pressure cools in parts of the US market, lenders are looking ahead to another potential test: refinancing. Blue Owl executives told sell-side analysts that software portfolio performance had remained broadly stable but refinancing risk could become more important as loans mature, particularly around 2028. At Blue Owl Technology Finance Corp., software non-accruals stood at 0.1% of fair value and 0.6% of cost, while median revenue growth and free-cash-flow margins had been stable for four quarters, according to Truist Securities. Blue Owl management said stronger borrowers should be able to extend loans on tighter terms, while weaker credits may need to reduce leverage materially or could ultimately be sold or handed over to lenders.

item.title: Chevron elevates CFO to head oil and gas operations
item.description: Chevron Chief Financial Officer Eimear Bonner will become president of the US oil producer's oil, products and gas business, the company said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Sheila Dang, Katha Kalia
item.content:encoded: Chevron (CVX.N) Chief Financial Officer Eimear Bonner will become president of the US oil producer's oil, products and gas business, the company said on Monday. Jeff Gustavson, currently president of Chevron's new energies business, will succeed Bonner as CFO. Both moves are effective January 1. The executive reshuffling comes as the second-largest U.S. oil producer is preparing for CEO Mike Wirth to hand over the reins. In December, Wirth said he was in discussions with the board about [USN:L6N3XF12V TEXT:"succession"] and did not expect to serve more than 10 years in the role. The oil major also said Mark Nelson, currently head of the oil, products and gas business, will depart the role on January 1 but remain vice chairman and oversee strategy and business development. Prior to becoming Chevron's finance chief, Bonner was the company's first female chief technology officer. She also previously served as general director of Chevron's joint venture, Tengizchevroil, which operates the largest oilfield in Kazakhstan. As head of new energies, Gustavson oversaw the company's first foray into powering data centers with natural gas.

item.title: Ellison retains Thompson as CNN chief, unveils Skydance leadership team
item.description: CNN CEO Mark Thompson will continue in his leadership roles at the news network under David Ellison-led Skydance, the company that will come into effect on Tuesday following the $110 billion merger of Paramount and Warner Bros Discovery .
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: CNN CEO Mark Thompson will continue in his leadership roles at the news network under David Ellison-led Skydance, the company that will come into effect on Tuesday following the $110 billion merger of Paramount (PSKY.O) and Warner Bros Discovery (WBD.O) . His counterpart at CBS News, Bari Weiss, will also keep her role and both will report to CEO Ellison and newly appointed co-CEO Ynon Kreiz, Paramount said on Monday. The separate reporting structure allays concerns that Weiss, who took over as CBS News editor-in-chief in 2025, would have greater control over all of Skydance's news operations. Ellison and Thompson had held talks in recent weeks about a new contract that would keep the chairman and editor-in-chief of CNN in those roles but had not settled on the terms, [USN:L4N45N15W TEXT:"Reuters reported"] last week, citing a source. On Monday, Thompson told CNN staff he will lead "with the same responsibilities and prerogatives" that he has so far, but the specifics on how CNN will operate within the new company is yet to be finalized, according to an internal memo seen by Reuters. Thompson said in the note he had "real confidence" that the new leadership would "fully support the principle and practice of the kind of independent news that CNN has always stood for". As part of a settlement with a coalition of 12 U.S. states and a Hollywood writers' union, Ellison had agreed to set up an editorial independence board to oversee CNN and CBS News. However, journalists and media experts [USN:L4N45E0EO TEXT:"have been skeptical about"] the five-member board over how much authority it will have in practice. The members will be appointed and paid by Skydance, but the settlement does not explicitly give the board investigative powers and leaves unclear whether its decisions will be binding. The latest appointments comes as both companies face pressure on their traditional television businesses, with audiences and advertising shifting from linear networks to streaming. Other senior appointments included Paramount operations chief Andy Gordon as president of Skydance, while finance chief Dennis Cinelli will continue in the role. HBO head Casey Bloys will become chief content officer at Skydance's direct-to-consumer business, while George Cheeks will co-lead Skydance's newly formed television division.

item.title: Azúcar sube hasta 2% y alcanza máximo desde 2024 ante riesgos climáticos y de oferta
item.description: El contrato más activo en Nueva York subió hasta un 2%, alcanzando su nivel más alto desde el 17 de diciembre de 2024. La sesión del lunes se basó en la ganancia de casi el 8% registrada la semana pas ...
item.dc:creator: Eleanor Thomber
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Los futuros del azúcar crudo extendieron sus ganancias, ante la creciente preocupación por una menor oferta mundial debido a las condiciones climáticas y los problemas de producción entre los principales productores. El contrato más activo en Nueva York subió hasta un 2%, alcanzando su nivel más alto desde el 17 de diciembre de 2024. La sesión del lunes se basó en la ganancia de casi el 8% registrada la semana pasada. El azúcar blanco también subió. Ver más: Morgan Stanley ve oportunidades en acciones industriales de EE.UU. tras la caída de valoraciones El fenómeno meteorológico de El Niño está generando preocupación por el suministro en todo el sector agrícola, y se prevé que el azúcar sea uno de los primeros cultivos afectados. A principios de año, se pronosticaba un exceso de oferta, pero los riesgos climáticos han cambiado esa perspectiva y ahora se prevé un déficit. “La preocupación por las condiciones meteorológicas está impulsando el último repunte de los precios del azúcar, que están a punto de poner a prueba los máximos de agosto”, dijo Chris Beauchamp, analista jefe de mercado de la plataforma de inversión y negociación IG. Las lluvias excesivas han ralentizado la cosecha y la molienda de la caña de azúcar en Brasil, el principal productor. En la India, el segundo mayor productor, el monzón más débil desde 2015 ha reducido la producción prevista de azúcar a unos 30 millones de toneladas. En Europa, se prevé que los rendimientos de la remolacha azucarera se sitúen un 11% por debajo de la media de los últimos cinco años, según la unidad de Seguimiento de Recursos Agrícolas de la Unión Europea. Ver más: Del azúcar a la madera: materias primas agrícolas que ganaron y perdieron en el tercer trimestre Si bien una menor producción en una región suele compensarse con una mayor producción en otra, las condiciones adversas en varios países productores clave al mismo tiempo podrían mermar ese colchón. “Parece que el mercado está convencido de que la producción de azúcar quedará muy por debajo de las estimaciones iniciales y recientes”, escribieron los analistas de Green Pool Global en una nota el lunes, en la que recortaron en un 3% su previsión de producción de azúcar para la región centro-sur de Brasil en la campaña 2026/27. Los gestores de fondos se mostraron más optimistas respecto al azúcar en bruto al liquidar sus posiciones bajistas, con las posiciones cortas directas cayendo a su nivel más bajo en más de 21 meses, según datos de la CFTC a 29 de septiembre. --Con la colaboración de Will Standring. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: Premier League viewership up 20% among young Americans, Nielsen Sports data shows
item.description: The Premier League has struck a chord with young Americans after the US co-hosted this year's World Cup, with viewership for the English top-flight up 20% among those aged 18-34 so far this season, shows data from Nielsen Sports released on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Premier League has struck a chord with young Americans after the US co-hosted this year's World Cup, with viewership for the English top-flight up 20% among those aged 18-34 so far this season, shows data from Nielsen Sports released on Monday. US broadcasters NBC and the USA Network have drawn an average of half a million viewers for Premier League games this season, marking a 3% rise, as the sport's popularity has grown. "The World Cup served as a powerful catalyst, expanding the Premier League’s footprint across a far broader demographic in the US," said Jon Stainer, global GM at Nielsen Sports. "Our data shows that fandom is not only reaching record highs but it is also expanding rapidly among younger, diverse audiences and carrying over into major domestic and international leagues." Just over one million Americans watched Tottenham Hotspur's 2-0 home defeat by Newcastle United on August 29, the Premier League's most-watched match in the US this season so far. Spurs have been involved in three of the six most-watched Premier League games in the US this season, as their 3-0 loss at Brentford and 0-0 home draw with Everton also made the list. Major League Soccer also benefited from the rising exposure of soccer in the lead-up to the World Cup, with interest jumping 23% among 16-34 year olds. Interest in the World Cup peaked at 87 million fans in July, with female supporters accounting for 44% of the total fanbase, according to Nielsen Fan Insights, which collects data from half-hour online surveys with a sample size of 3,000 in the US.

AMSTERDAM, Oct 5 : German robotics maker RobCo on Monday said it had passed a $1 billion valuation and that its CEO Roman Holzl had relocated to the United States to focus on the company's fastest-growing market. The Munich-based firm said the valuation was based on a secondary sale of shares following a $100 million capital raise in January with investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia and Lingotto. In the secondary sale, employees sold shares to existing and new investors including Cherry Ventures and the European Tech Collective. The Wall Street Journal, which first reported Monday's transaction and valuation, said the transaction involved the sale of $40 million worth of shares.

The company joins a small but growing group of European robotics startups valued at $1 billion or more that are targeting the emerging humanoid and human-like robot market, including NEURA Robotics and Agile Robots of Germany, and Humanoid of the UK. Founded in 2020, RobCo makes robots used in manufacturing. It said it will in March launch Alfie, a two-armed, self-learning robot designed to perform tasks in industrial settings that can't easily be done with traditional automation. The company, which has operations in Austin and San Francisco in addition to its Munich base, said it now has customers in more than a dozen US states.

item.title: France, Germany propose new rapid EU trade response tool
item.description: France and Germany have proposed the European Union toughen itself up with a new rapid-action measure to strike back against countries that harm the bloc economically in a new world where trade is increasingly used as a weapon.
item.dc:creator: Philip Blenkinsop, Andreas Rinke
item.content:encoded: France and Germany have proposed the European Union toughen itself up with a new rapid-action measure to strike back against countries that harm the bloc economically in a new world where trade is increasingly used as a weapon. German officials said the EU needed a tool as powerful as the Section 301 tariffs imposed by the United States or China's restrictions on exports of critical minerals. The new measure would not target any specific country, but highlights dumping, widespread subsidies and restriction of currency convertibility — market distortions that many EU leaders say China is engaged in. A French-German document published on Monday, 10 days before EU leaders discuss Chinese trade imbalances at a summit in Brussels, said "systemic and persistent market distortions" jeopardise the European economy and particularly its industrial base, with widespread job losses. The bloc, said the document, needs to deploy its trade defence tools more swiftly and efficiently, with more investigations and a broader approach to cover whole sectors. France and Germany also said the European Commission should propose two new instruments as soon as possible to focus EU efforts on diversification and securing economic security. The first, which the Commission has [USN:L6N42D0SI TEXT:"already mentioned"], would seek to limit companies' reliance on single sources for certain critical supplies. The second would limit access to the EU single market for countries that undermine fair market conditions through political or economic means, without specifying what the trigger for EU reaction would be or what action the EU should take. The paper said that any proposal by the Commission to activate counter-measures against another country should be adopted unless a qualified majority of EU members opposed — a lower hurdle than for some trade measures. The paper also said the Commission should be able to activate such new measures swiftly, which German government officials said could mean a matter of days. Legislation to enact a new instrument would still need approval by EU governments and the European Parliament. A French presidential adviser said it was urgent for the EU to take action, that the imbalances with some trade partners had become unsustainable, and that France and Germany were keen for the bloc to deploy existing anti-dumping measures as soon as possible. "France and Germany are very keen to put an end to the naivete on trade," the adviser told reporters.

item.title: C.H. Robinson to buy RXO for $5.8 billion in truck broking expansion
item.description: Freight forwarding firm C.H. Robinson Worldwide said on Monday it would buy RXO in a stock-and-cash transaction for $5.8 billion, as it looks to strengthen its footprint in North America's truck brokerage business.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Freight forwarding firm C.H. Robinson Worldwide (CHRW.O) said on Monday it would buy RXO (RXO.N) in a stock-and-cash transaction for $5.8 billion, as it looks to strengthen its footprint in North America's truck brokerage business. The $25 billion combined logistics firm will fold the tech-enabled truck brokerage primarily into C.H. Robinson's North American Surface Transportation unit, which accounts for over two-thirds of revenue. RXO, which also offers managed transportation and last-mile delivery, saw its shares jump 23%, while C.H. Robinson sank 10% in early trading. RXO shareholders would receive $17.25 in cash and 0.0856 C.H. Robinson shares for each RXO share, valuing the company at $30.25 per share, a 29% premium to Friday's close. The deal would expand C.H. Robinson's last-mile delivery coverage in the US and help it win more large corporate customers, strengthening its position in the highly competitive truck brokerage market. C.H. Robinson CEO Dave Bozeman said the deal would allow the company "to create a more scaled, resilient North American third-party logistics provider." Once the deal closes, the company expects $300 million of net run-rate cost synergies within two years, with the deal becoming accretive to adjusted earnings per share within nine months. Over the last year, C.H. Robinson has reduced its headcount as AI agents took over pricing shipments, coordinating pickups and deliveries, and monitoring cargo in transit. RXO, meanwhile, reported annual losses in 2024 and 2025, but beat profit expectations in its most recent quarter, thanks to improved pricing. Freight brokers have benefited from an uptick in trucking rates in the US, amid a regulatory-driven driver shortage, boosting their revenue. However, sharp swings in diesel prices are squeezing margins, as fuel surcharges and spot rates often lag cost increases, creating short-term cash-flow pressure. The deal, expected to close in the first half of 2027, will give RXO shareholders ownership of 11% of the combined company. (This story has been refiled to add the dropped company name 'RXO' in the headline.)

item.title: Yémen Les forces gouvernementales ont lancé une offensive sur Sanaa, progressent vers Bab el-Mandeb
item.description: Les forces armées gouvernementales yéménites ont annoncé lundi avoir lancé une "offensive stratégique" sur Sanaa, la capitale du Yémen, afin de reprendre le contrôle de la ville aux mains des rebelles houthis pro-iraniens.
item.dc:creator: Timour Azhari, Mohammed Ghobari
item.content:encoded: Les forces armées gouvernementales yéménites ont annoncé lundi avoir lancé une "offensive stratégique" sur Sanaa, la capitale du Yémen, afin de reprendre le contrôle de la ville aux mains des rebelles houthis pro-iraniens. Les forces gouvernementales yéménites, soutenues par l'Arabie saoudite, se sont également emparées lundi de positions clés dans le détroit de Bab el-Mandeb, ont indiqué des sources militaires et gouvernementales, alors que les Houthis ont avancé le mois dernier vers cette voie navigable stratégique. Une grande partie du district de Dhoubab, qui surplombe Bab el-Mandeb, est désormais sous le contrôle de l'armée yéménite, grâce à un soutien aérien massif de la coalition dirigée par l'Arabie saoudite, ont déclaré à Reuters trois sources militaires et une source gouvernementale. Le ministre yéménite de l'Information, Moammar al-Eryani, a précisé à Reuters que l'armée gouvernementale s'était emparée de la piste d'atterrissage de Dhoubab. Située sur le littoral occidental, Dhoubab abrite une base militaire à une trentaine de kilomètres du détroit de Bab el-Mandeb, verrou vers la mer Rouge. Une source militaire gouvernementale affirme toutefois que des combats se poursuivent dans et autour de la base où se trouve la piste d'atterrissage. Dimanche, le président yéménite, Rachad al Alimi, a annoncé le lancement d'une vaste opération militaire visant à reprendre le contrôle des territoires occupés par les Houthis. Les Houthis contrôlent la capitale depuis 2014, ainsi qu'une grande partie du nord-ouest du pays, où vit la majeure partie de la population. Les médias proches des Houthis avaient auparavant nié toute progression des forces gouvernementales dans la région. Le ministère houthiste de la Santé a fait état de deux morts et sept blessés dans des bombardements de l'armée gouvernementale sur Sanhan et Sa'wan, dans la province de Sanaa. Les combats font rage depuis des semaines sur plusieurs fronts au Yémen, alors que la guerre civile, globalement latente depuis 2022, a regagné en intensité avec le conflit entre les États-Unis et l'Iran. Les Houthis ont notamment entrepris de prendre le contrôle du détroit stratégique de Bab el-Mandeb, et ont lancé plusieurs attaques contre l'Arabie saoudite - alliée des Etats-Unis - et en mer Rouge depuis leur annonce en juillet dernier d'un blocus maritime des ports saoudiens. Alors que les exportations énergétiques du Golfe sont déjà limitées par la fermeture du détroit d'Ormuz par l’Iran, les combats au Yémen menacent cette autre voie énergétique majeure, ce qui a fait grimper les prix mondiaux et fait naître de nouveaux risques. L’Arabie saoudite, qui arme et forme les forces yéménites, soutient la campagne militaire du gouvernement (en exil à Aden)par sa puissance aérienne et a sollicité l’aide logistique de ses alliés pour repousser les Houthis, rétablir la libre circulation en mer Rouge et mettre fin aux attaques sur son territoire. COMBATS VIOLENTS SE DÉROULENT DANS LE SUD-OUEST DU YÉMEN Les combats les plus violents ces derniers jours ont eu lieu dans le sud-ouest du Yémen, tant dans la zone côtière près du détroit de Bab el-Mandeb qu'autour de la ville de Taïz, dans le sud-ouest, où les Houthis tentent d’encercler les forces gouvernementales. Une agence de presse contrôlée par le groupe rebelle a cité lundi une source militaire affirmant que les Houthis avait chassé les forces gouvernementales du district d’al-Mawasit, dans la province de Taïz, et avait atteint une résidence de Rachad al Alimi. Au cours du week-end, les Houthis ont progressé sur la dernière route reliant Taïz à Aden. La prise de contrôle par les Houthis de la route de Taïz-Aden entraînerait un siège de fait de Taïz, troisième plus grande ville du Yémen, où vivent des centaines de milliers de civils et où sont également stationnés des milliers de soldats des forces gouvernementales. La ville revêt une importance qui ne tient pas uniquement à sa position stratégique : le président yéménite Rachad al Alimi est originaire de cette région et le siège de Taïz exacerberait une situation humanitaire déjà désastreuse dans le pays. La famine au Yémen s'aggrave, avec un nombre record d'habitants incapables de subvenir à leurs besoins alimentaires, a déclaré vendredi le Programme alimentaire mondial (PAM). Le conflit au Yémen a éclaté après la prise de Sanaa par les Houthis en 2014, ce qui a poussé une coalition menée par l’Arabie saoudite à intervenir l’année suivante pour rétablir le gouvernement et chasser le groupe soutenu par l’Iran. Les combats se sont rapidement enlisés dans une impasse sanglante, la plupart des lignes de front étant bloquées. Un cessez-le-feu conclu en 2022 s'est maintenu jusqu’à l'été dernier.

item.title: AirBaltic plans to cut up to 700 jobs
item.description: Latvian airline airBaltic said on Monday it is preparing to cut about 500 to 700 jobs across its bases in Riga, Vilnius and Tallinn.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Latvian airline airBaltic said on Monday it is preparing to cut about 500 to 700 jobs across its bases in Riga, Vilnius and Tallinn. The carrier [USN:L6N4560BC TEXT:"filed"] for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in New York in September, aiming to complete a sweeping restructuring focused on cutting its mounting debt through capacity and fleet reductions. AirBaltic gained [USN:L6N4580GU TEXT:"approval last month"] to access €140 million ($157 million) from a wider €350 million financing package. CEO Erno Hilden told Reuters in September that the airline [USN:L6N456122 TEXT:"was in talks"] with labour unions over "an adjustment" to the workforce. New organisational structures for the rest of the company are expected to be defined by mid-October, airBaltic said, with the final number of layoffs potentially changing within the course of the process. Dace Kavasa, chairperson of the Latvian aviation union, told Reuters there was "pure union busting" going on at the moment after management condemned a proposal for staff to take 85% part-time work. "We learned about 500 to 700 people, six minutes before they started an employee meeting where they presented this," Kavasa said, adding that any talks will only start on October 15. ($1 = 0.8922 euros)

FAST

ROME, Oct 5 : Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has applied to the European Union Intellectual Property Office (EUIPO) to trademark her voice in a new move to protect herself against AI-generated deepfakes, records showed on Monday. Her application, dated October 5 on the EUIPO website and confirmed by her office, includes a four-second audio recording of herself twice repeating the phrase, in Italian, "I am Giorgia Meloni." "Io sono Giorgia" ("I am Giorgia") was the title of her 2021 autobiography that echoed a famous declaration Meloni made at a political rally in 2019 and which was even turned into a disco track. Manipulated images of Meloni have repeatedly circulated online in recent years and have at times been shared as authentic, including one depicting her sitting on a bed in her underwear.

Meloni has denounced such material as part of efforts to spread falsehoods and target individuals, urging users to verify content before sharing it online. She has said that while she is able to defend herself, many others are not. The EUIPO application is still under examination.  Italian media have reported that even if approved, it would not by itself prevent the use of her voice in AI-generated deepfakes, though it could create additional legal obstacles for those seeking to replicate it. In 2024, Meloni launched a civil action against a man from Sardinia accused of creating and posting online deepfake pornographic images using her face. The case remains pending before an Italian court.

Source: Reuters

FAST

Oct 5 : Norway striker Erling Haaland is showing signs of physical fatigue following a relentless run of matches for club and country, raising concerns over his punishing workload. The 26-year-old Manchester City forward was substituted after 67 minutes as Norway lost 2-1 away to Portugal in Nations League Group A4 on Sunday. Haaland was among several high-profile players who left the stadium straight after the match on a private jet to make the most of a brief holiday before returning to club duties. "He was simply thoroughly spent," Norway manager Stale Solbakken said of Haaland's condition.

"Some of my players have only had six or seven days of holiday. And you do not live off your physical condition in a normal job. Then it is straight into the start of the season, followed by a mini-tournament, so it is an extreme strain." "He’s in the group that carries the heaviest workload — precisely because his team (Manchester City) plays in every tournament and he’s the main man," Solbakken added. Norway midfielder Patrick Berg echoed his manager's assessment, noting the physical toll on Haaland. "He has played all three (Norway) games before this one, so it's not that shocking his strength finally ran out," Berg said. Haaland has endured a gruelling schedule in recent months. Norway's run to the World Cup quarter-finals significantly cut short his off-season and he has since featured in every Premier League match for City, scoring five goals. Haaland highlighted the relentless schedule on social media after a two-goal performance in the 3-2 Nations League win over Denmark last month, posting: "So tired. New match in 70 hours." NORWEGIAN PLAYERS' UNION CONCERNED Norwegian players' union NISO expressed concern over the escalating match schedule for the country's leading athletes. "Over time, we have seen a worrying trend where the burden on top players has become far too high," NISO chief Kristoffer Vatshaug said in a press release on Monday. "It has already had consequences for several players. This is serious. "We want clearer guidelines for workload and recovery. It is about the time between matches, consecutive rest periods, travel strain and how much time players get to recover after a long season." Vatshaug said the responsibility does not rest with individual players. "We cannot have a system where protecting players depends on them saying stop themselves. Footballers want to play football. They want to turn out for their club, national team and teammates." Haaland has six days to recover before City resume their Premier League campaign at Liverpool on Sunday.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Energy stocks weigh on TSX as oil prices ease
item.description: Canada's resource-heavy main stock index fell on Monday as lower oil prices weighed on energy stocks, though gains in technology shares limited losses, while investors parsed economic data and reassessed interest rate expectations.
item.dc:creator: Avinash P
item.content:encoded: Canada's resource-heavy main stock index fell on Monday as lower oil prices weighed on energy stocks, though gains in technology shares limited losses, while investors parsed economic data and reassessed interest rate expectations. The Toronto Stock Exchange's S&P/TSX Composite Index (.GSPTSE) was down 0.2% at 35,441.80 points by 10:10 am ET, after rising nearly 1% on Friday. Lower oil prices weighed on the energy sector (.SPTTEN) , which was down 0.9% on Monday, leading sector-wise losses The mining linked-materials sector (.GSPTTMT) fell 0.8%, while the information technology index (.SPTTTK) gained 1.9% Investors recalculated their monetary policy expectations after soft [USN:L1N45N170 TEXT:"US jobs data"] last week eased fears of an imminent Fed rate increase. Traders are currently pricing in a roughly 20% chance of a rate hike at the U.S. central bank's meeting later this month, according to CME's FedWatch tool. While odds of an October rate hike by the Bank of Canada have receded, investors still expect the central bank to raise lending rates at least once before the end of 2026, according to LSEG-compiled data "The question is whether it is simply a 25-basis-point move or the beginning of a broader rate-hike cycle... that is what is causing some angst and why we have seen a little volatility in the Canadian market lately," said Shiraz Ahmed, founder and CEO of Sartorial Wealth Among individual movers, Canada's Suncor Energy (SU.TO) fell 1.2% after it [USN:L6N45R01S TEXT:"agreed to sell its interests"] in three offshore oil assets to Ithaca Energy (ITH.L) for C$1.2 billion ($841.69 million) Cenovus Energy (CVE.TO) fell 4.1% after saying it would acquire Athabasca Oil (ATH.TO) in a [USN:L4N45R0J0 TEXT:"cash-and-stock transaction"] valued at C$5.7 billion ($4.00 billion). Athabasca Oil jumped more than 15% On the data front, Canada's services [USN:L6N45L0U9 TEXT:"economy contracted"] for a fourth straight month in September amid economic uncertainty, S&P Global's Canada services PMI data showed.

item.title: 日豪が「財務相対話」設置、毎年協議へ 経済安保協力を強化
item.description:
Takaya Yamaguchi
［東京 ５日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Takaya Yamaguchi

［東京　５日　ロイター］ - 日豪両政府は５日、両国財務相による「財務相対話」を設置すると発表した。毎年協議する閣僚級の枠組みを設置し、財務、金融分野の協力を促進する狙い。経済安全保障分野での２国間協力も強化する。

日本の片山さつき財務相とジム・チャルマーズ豪財務相が同日、覚書に署名した。日本は中国、韓国とそれぞれ閣僚級の対話の枠組みを持っており、今回の設置で３カ国目の財務相対話となる。

オーストラリアは天然資源が豊富で、日本は液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）の輸入実績がある。レアアースなどの重要鉱物も保有するオーストラリアとの対話を通じ、広く協力関係を深めたい考え。

片山財務相は調印式で「新たな対話の枠組みを活用しつつ、日本はオーストラリアとの連携をさらに強化し、両国をはじめとするインド太平洋地域、世界全体の安定的な経済成長に向けて貢献していく」と述べた。

日豪対話に先立ち、日本は２００６年に韓国、中国と財務相対話の枠組みを設置した。ただ、中国とは１８年を最後に財務相対話を行っていない。

item.title: S&P 500 up, Nasdaq at record high as megacap tech stocks rise
item.description: The benchmark S&P 500 rose and the Nasdaq reached all-time highs on Monday as most megacap and growth stocks advanced, though risk sentiment remained in check as Treasury yields held near multi-year highs.
item.dc:creator: Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Shashwat Chauhan
item.content:encoded: The benchmark S&P 500 rose and the Nasdaq reached all-time highs on Monday as most megacap and growth stocks advanced, though risk sentiment remained in check as Treasury yields held near multi-year highs. Heavyweight tech stocks took the lead in early trading, with Nvidia (NVDA.O) rising 1.1%, hovering close to its record high hit in the previous session. Meta Platforms (META.O) , Microsoft (MSFT.O) and Tesla (TSLA.O) all added more than 1%. Seven of the 11 S&P 500 sectors were trading higher, with communication services (.SPLRCL) and utilities (.SPLRCU) leading gains. Chip stocks were weak early on with the Philadelphia chips index (.SOX) down 0.3%, while software-related companies were among the top gainers. The S&P 500 software & services index (.SPLRCIS) rose 1.4%. PTC (PTC.O) was the top gainer on the S&P 500, rising 34.6% after France's Schneider Electric (SCHN.PA) agreed to [USN:L6N45Q07P TEXT:"acquire"] the software firm in a $22.6 billion all-cash deal. At 10:19 a.m. ET, the Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) fell 66.35 points, or 0.13%, to 51,110.61, the S&P 500 (.SPX) gained 30.33 points, or 0.39%, to 7,753.05 and the Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) gained 167.85 points, or 0.62%, to 27,360.28. Optimism about robust corporate earnings has helped US stocks outperform global rivals in the last six months, despite the shaky geopolitical landscape and inflation worries. Goldman Sachs analysts expect most companies will "once again surpass consensus earnings estimates this quarter," noting 9% year-on-year earnings growth for the median S&P 500 stock. "Many investors expect higher yields to derail the equity rally, but I think the market still has enough momentum to push through further increases in interest rates," said Peter Andersen, founder of Andersen Capital Management. However, risk sentiment remained subdued as government bond yields held near their highs. The benchmark 10-year U.S. Treasury yields were last at 5.296% amid concerns over deteriorating government finances, heavy debt issuance and elevated energy costs. Global bond markets were in focus on worries over [USN:L6N45O0HP TEXT:"France's debt burden"] and political uncertainty ahead of next year's presidential election. Meanwhile, the Nasdaq (.IXIC) hit another record high after last week's jump on softer-than-expected jobs data that doused chances of an October interest rate hike. Fresh data on Monday showed US [USN:S0N44H007 TEXT:"services sector"] activity slowed in September. Traders now see an 80% chance of the Federal Reserve holding interest rates steady this month, though a December rate hike remains largely priced in, according to the CME FedWatch tool. Brent crude futures hovered near the psychologically important $100-a-barrel level as concerns over Gulf oil infrastructure disruptions amid the ongoing US-Israel war persisted. Among other movers, RXO (RXO.N) advanced 22.5% after freight forwarding firm C.H. Robinson Worldwide (CHRW.O) agreed [USN:L4N45R0MP TEXT:"to buy"] the transportation broker in a stock-and-cash transaction for $5.8 billion. C.H. Robinson fell 11.8%. [USN:L4N45O1CT TEXT:"Cerebras Systems"] (CBRS.O) rose 9.5% after OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said the chip designer is a "close partner" and that the companies have "deep engagement pushing on the frontiers of speed." Advancing issues outnumbered decliners by a 1.04-to-1 ratio on the NYSE and by a 1.09-to-1 ratio on the Nasdaq. The S&P 500 posted 3 new 52-week highs and 18 new lows while the Nasdaq Composite recorded 23 new highs and 157 new lows.

GDANSK, Poland, Oct 5 : Poland's antitrust watchdog said on Monday it suspected Alphabet's Google of abusing its dominant market position while negotiating content payments with domestic media publishers. The Office of Competition and Consumer Protection, known by its Polish abbreviation UOKiK, said the charges relate to how Google negotiates remuneration for displaying articles and snippets in its search results, Google News and Discover services. The companies named in the statement are Alphabet Inc, Google LLC, Google Ireland Limited and Google Poland, none of which immediately responded to a Reuters request for comment. UOKiK alleges Google failed to provide publishers with the necessary data to properly assess offers, leading to an information imbalance that prevented fair negotiations on payment for content.

"Big tech companies cannot place themselves above the law," UOKiK President Tomasz Chrostny said in the statement, adding the lack of data led to negotiations becoming illusory and tending towards Google imposing terms. The dispute stems from a 2024 Polish copyright law amendment that implemented an EU directive under which online services may use press publishers' content in return for remuneration. The maximum fine for abusing a dominant market position may amount to 10 per cent of a company's turnover, the regulator said. It added the investigation was separate from the European Commission probe opened in December 2025 into whether Google used publishers' content in its AI services without adequate compensation or giving them the ability to object. The Polish probe, which focuses on Google Search, Google News and Discover services, is being carried out independently following an agreement with the Commission, UOKiK said. In December 2024, Polish e-commerce group Allegro's price comparison platform Ceneo sued Alphabet for 2.33 billion zlotys ($568 million) in damages for alleged anti-competitive behaviour.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 原油価格、下限は70ドルに上昇へ＝コノコフィリップス会長
item.description: [ロンドン ５日 ロイター] - 米石油・ガス大手コノコフィリップスのライアン・ランス会長は５日、原油価格の下限が１...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
原油価格、下限は70ドルに上昇へ＝コノコフィリップス会長 10/5 19:39 配信

コノコフィリップスのライアン・ランス会長、3月24日撮影 REUTERS/Danielle Villasana

[ロンドン ５日 ロイター] - 米石油・ガス大手コノコフィリップスのライアン・ランス会長は５日、原油価格の下限が１バレル＝７０ドル前後まで上昇すると予想しており、米原油指標ウェスト・テキサス・インターミディエート（ＷＴＩ）のミッドサイクル価格は同６５─７０ドルになると見込んでいると述べた。

ロンドンで開催された「エネルギー・インテリジェンス・フォーラム」で、今年の中東紛争により世界の石油システムは大きな打撃を受けたものの、崩壊には至らなかったと語った。

原油価格が現在の水準付近で推移すれば、米石油生産量は日量１４００万─１４５０万バレルを超える可能性があるという。

世界の石油需要が現在の危機から回復するには２０２８年か２９年までかかる可能性があるものの、その後は需要の伸びを止めるものは何もないと述べた。

「当社のような企業にとって真の戦略的課題は、その増加する需要を満たすために、伝統的な（生産）資源をどこから確保するかという点だ」と語り、コノコフィリップスは現在、石油事業では中流投資よりも上流投資に重点を置いていると付け加えた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：石油価格、イラン攻撃による急騰から持久戦へ コラム：ホルムズ封鎖で石油貿易に変化、米州が最大の受益者に アングル：世界の石油備蓄、イラン戦争長期化による大規模供給途絶を乗り切れるか 焦点：エジプト沖ドローン攻撃が脅かす原油輸送代替ルート、スエズ運河巡る安全性に懸念 アングル：原油価格、イラン紛争でも予想ほど急騰しなかった訳 最終更新: 10/5(月) 19:39 ロイター

item.title: Brazil's currency, stocks jump after Bolsonaro scores first-round upset
item.description: The Bovespa benchmark stock index gained more than 9% and the country's currency strengthened against the US dollar.
item.dc:creator: Oliver Griffin, Marcela Ayres, Gabriel Araujo
item.content:encoded: Brazilian assets rallied on Monday after right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro outperformed opinion polls to finish first in the first round of Sunday's presidential election, with the Bovespa (.BVSP) benchmark stock index gaining more than 9% and the country's currency strengthening against the US dollar. The eldest son of former President Jair Bolsonaro won 47% of the votes cast and will face leftist incumbent President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, who secured about 45%, in a runoff on October 25. Polls had forecast Lula would lead the first round of voting by around three percentage points. Investors cheered on Monday morning as Bolsonaro's strong showing was matched by gains for his allies in Congress. Analysts say a friendlier legislature would make it easier for him, if elected, to push through a pro-market agenda of tighter public spending, privatizations and tax cuts. "Brazil wants change," Flavio Bolsonaro said on Sunday evening, heralding the "end of the era of (Lula's) Workers' Party." Shares in retailer Magazine Luiza (MGLU3.SA) , stock exchange operator B3 (B3SA3.SA) , lender BTG Pactual , homebuilder Cyrela (CYRE3.SA) and conglomerate Cosan (CSAN3.SA) jumped more than 20% each, putting them among the top gainers. Pulpmaker Suzano (SUZB3.SA) , on the other hand, fell as much as 8.5%. Brazil's real currency strengthened more than 4% against the US dollar in early trading, moving below 5.00 per greenback, from around 5.22 previously, in line with analyst forecasts and with the [USN:L1N3130Q9 TEXT:"currency's performance four years ago"] when then-President Jair Bolsonaro did better than expected in the first-round vote against Lula. Jair Bolsonaro went on to lose to Lula in the second round of that election and was subsequently convicted of trying to carry out a coup to overturn the result. The former president was sentenced to about 27 years in prison and is currently under house arrest. Brazil's international debt also rallied on Monday, while broader fixed-income markets were jittery. The 2056 bond was up 1.4 cents on the dollar to bid at 93.5 cents, Tradeweb data showed. 'THE MARKET WANTS CHANGE' Flavio Bolsonaro has [USN:L6N3XR02X TEXT:"pitched himself"] as a "more centered" version of his father to investors concerned about Brazil's burgeoning fiscal pressures. "It remains to be seen whether the senator would ultimately prove more fiscally responsible than Lula would be in a fourth non-consecutive presidential term. However, markets are likely to give him the benefit of the doubt," said Thierry Larose, portfolio manager at Vontobel. Analysts also expect the real to continue strengthening into 2027. Societe Generale forecast that it will firm to 5.10 by end-2026, with scope to move below 5.00 in the first half of 2027. Morgan Stanley forecast the real could strengthen past 4.90 and toward 4.50 in the first quarter of next year. "The market wants change, it wants reform; it doesn't want a high public deficit; with the current government, all of this will continue," said Pedro Galdi, investment analyst at the AGF Investments platform. Bolsonaro's strong showing is likely to boost market confidence in the near term, said Bryan Harris, a managing partner at Sabio. "The market will be looking for clear signals from Bolsonaro that he is serious about tackling the country's problems," Harris said. Heading into Sunday's vote, most private polls, which largely underestimated Flavio Bolsonaro's strength, had shown the 45-year-old senator and Lula, who will turn 81 later this month, about even in a runoff vote. Addressing a crowd at a hotel in Sao Paulo, Lula said he had been convinced he would win the election in the first round. "Starting tomorrow, we begin a new campaign," he said, promising to show voters what he had accomplished as president.

item.title: India markets regulator to partly reverse derivative settlement rules after pushback, sources say
item.description: India's markets regulator is likely to stop using closing auctions to calculate derivatives settlement prices for at least a year, two sources with direct knowledge of the matter said, in a partial reversal of new mechanisms it has introduced for setting the closing prices of key stocks and derivative contracts.
item.dc:creator: Jayshree Pyasi
item.content:encoded: India's markets regulator is likely to stop using closing auctions to calculate derivatives settlement prices for at least a year, two sources with direct knowledge of the matter said, in a partial reversal of new mechanisms it has introduced for setting the closing prices of key stocks and derivative contracts. The Securities and Exchange Board of India in August introduced a new mechanism called the closing auction session, or CAS, for stocks that have futures and options contracts linked to them. Under this system, a short auction at the end of the trading day helps determine the closing price of a stock. The new process, similar to that used in global markets including the US and Hong Kong, has led to sharp swings in derivatives prices on expiry days, prompting the regulator to [USN:L1N45401R TEXT:"review it"]. In a post on social media platform X over the weekend, SEBI said it had received 20,000 suggestions to tweak the rules in response to a consultation paper issued last month. Sources said that instead, the volume-weighted average price of the last 30 minutes of trading will be used to determine the derivative pricing. For underlying stocks in the less liquid cash market, a closing auction will still be used to determine the end-of-day price, said the sources, who declined to be identified as they are not authorised to speak to the media. SEBI is expected to implement the changes by the end of this month. A SEBI spokesperson did not respond to a request for comment. The new approach would align India more closely with US and European markets, where derivatives settlement is often determined using dedicated pricing mechanisms, including volume-weighted average prices over set trading periods, rather than a single closing auction. ROADMAP TO FULL IMPLEMENTATION The regulator had also proposed in its review plans in September to stop publishing the indicative value of an index and publish only the indicative prices of individual stocks during the 10-minute CAS window, arguing that the index value was still being determined. The majority of feedback comments it received said that sophisticated trading desks could reconstruct those values independently and that removing them would reduce transparency without addressing manipulation concerns, the sources said. "The regulator agrees but will push for greater awareness among investors that the underlying index price is only determined at the end of the 10-minute window," said the second source. The feedback also favoured keeping the existing timetable broadly intact, with regular trading continuing until 3:30 p.m. and derivatives trading until 3:45 p.m., as this would aid price discovery and better align derivatives trading with the cash market closing process.

item.title: ロシアとの武力衝突リスクに直面、ドイツ連邦情報局長官が警告
item.description:
Sabine Siebold
[ベルリン ５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Sabine Siebold

[ベルリン ５日 ロイター] - ドイツ連邦情報局（ＢＮＤ）のマルティン・イェーガー長官は５日、ロシアが欧州の民主主義諸国に対する「影の戦争」を強める中、ドイツがロシアとの武力衝突に陥るリスクに直面していると警告した。

議会で毎年行われる公聴会で「われわれがロシアと直面している対立は、新たな、より危険な局面を迎えている」と指摘。「ドイツはロシアとの武力衝突に巻き込まれる危険にさらされている。ライプツィヒでの攻撃未遂事件はその一例に過ぎない」と述べた。

ドイツ当局は、８月にライプツィヒ空港で発生したドローン（無人機）攻撃未遂事件にロシアが関与していると非難している。

item.description: Oct 5 : Defending champion Carlos Alcaraz overcame early wobbles on his serve to outclass fellow Spaniard Jaume Munar 5-7 6-3 6-1 and reach the Japan Open final on Monday, taking a step towards his first singles title after his comeback from a wrist injury.He will face Czech Jiri Lehecka in Tuesday's final.

Oct 5 : Defending champion Carlos Alcaraz overcame early wobbles on his serve to outclass fellow Spaniard Jaume Munar 5-7 6-3 6-1 and reach the Japan Open final on Monday, taking a step towards his first singles title after his comeback from a wrist injury. He will face Czech Jiri Lehecka in Tuesday's final. Alcaraz completed the career Grand Slam by capturing the Australian Open title in February but suffered the injury two months later and only came back at the US Open, where a quarter-final run hinted at a swift return to form. The 23-year-old, who moved through the gears during Team Europe's triumphant Laver Cup campaign last month, looked comfortable against qualifier Munar in Tokyo at 5-4 before gifting him the opening set with two shaky service games.

"I don't know what happened in the first set," said top seed Alcaraz, who dropped 16 consecutive points at the end of it. "I started the match well, got a break and was serving for the set, but I don't know what happened. It seems like I'm struggling every first set. "But the way that I come back every time, I think I'm just really happy about it. Jaume's a pretty tough player and these conditions suit him pretty well. I just tried to stay there as much as I could. "I made a couple of breaks that helped a lot to get a bit of confidence, then I started to play more aggressively." After a sluggish start to the second set, Alcaraz raised his level to force a decider and the seven-times major champion wore world number 49 Munar down with stunning shot-making to book a title clash with Lehecka on Tuesday. Lehecka beat eighth seed Valentin Vacherot 6-4 6-2 to make the final and stay on course for his first trophy of the season.
